title: Accounting for Nanofilm Contributions in Interfacial Free Energy Calculations Using Classical Density Functional Theory
summary: Fluid nanofilms play a fundamental role in nanoscale interfacial thermodynamics, yet their treatment in classical density functional theory (cDFT) remains incomplete. We investigate nanofilm interfacial properties using a cDFT framework built upon the perturbed-chain statistical associating fluid theory (PC-SAFT) for both fluid-fluid and fluid-solid interfacial systems. Comparison with molecular simulations shows that the long-standing numerical discrepancies regarding free-standing nanofilms persist in the PC-SAFT functional predictions, supporting the view that they stem from thermal capillary-wave fluctuations rather than deficiencies of the density functional itself, as such fluctuations are inherently neglected in the mean-field approximation adopted by standard cDFT. Importantly, we establish a thermodynamically consistent framework for interfacial free energy (IFE) calculation, which explicitly incorporates nanofilm thermodynamic contributions and redefines the effective fluid volume by excluding the solid-phase region. The proposed method exhibits excellent consistency with another method based on the relationship between IFE and disjoining pressure for fluid systems, while both fluid-fluid and fluid-solid IFEs differ substantially from those predicted by the conventional method. We find that neglecting nanofilm contributions induces prominent size-dependent variations in the IFE and contact angle of hemicylindrical droplets, which is inconsistent with the extensive literature. Different methods also lead to opposite signs of the line tension for a hemispherical argon nanodroplet on a strongly lyophobic surface. The proposed framework provides a unified molecular-level basis for understanding interfacial processes involving nanofilms, including wetting, nucleation, adsorption, and other phenomena that rely on the accurate evaluation of IFEs.

AI.tldr: 本文基于PC-SAFT的经典密度泛函理论(cDFT)建立了纳米薄膜界面性质的热力学一致框架，解决了传统方法忽略纳米薄膜热力学贡献导致的界面自由能(IFE)计算偏差问题，并揭示了毛细波涨落是cDFT与分子模拟之间数值差异的根源。
AI.motivation: 尽管cDFT被广泛用于研究纳米薄膜界面性质，但传统方法存在两个不足：(1) 对自由站立纳米薄膜的预测与分子模拟存在长期未解的数值偏差；(2) 界面自由能计算未纳入纳米薄膜的热力学贡献，导致尺寸依赖的IFE和接触角变化与文献结论不一致，且不同方法对线张力符号的预测截然相反。
AI.method: 基于PC-SAFT分子力场构建cDFT框架，处理流体-流体和流体-固体界面体系。提出热力学一致的IFE计算方法：明确排除固相区域以重新定义有效流体体积，并显式纳入纳米薄膜的热力学贡献。通过与基于分离压的IFE方法对比验证，并与传统方法进行系统性比较。
AI.result: (1) PC-SAFT功能预测仍存在与分子模拟的数值差异，支持该差异源于热力学毛细波涨落而非泛函本身的缺陷；(2) 新方法与基于分离压的方法高度一致；(3) 传统方法忽略纳米薄膜贡献导致IFE和接触角出现显著的尺寸依赖变化；(4) 不同方法对强疏液表面上半球形液滴的线张力符号给出相反结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的热力学一致框架为涉及纳米薄膜的界面过程（润湿、成核、吸附等）提供了统一的分子层面基础，尤其强调了准确评估IFE对于理解这些现象的关键意义。

title: Momentum Rescaling for Collapse to a Block Ehrenfest Dynamics
summary: The Ehrenfest with collapse to a block (TAB) algorithm has recently been demonstrated to efficiently and accurately simulate nonadiabatic molecular dynamics in dense manifolds of electronic states. TAB employs an Ehrenfest force for the classical nuclei, accompanied by stochastic collapses of the electronic density matrix to account for decoherence. Energy conservation dictates that the nuclear momentum be adjusted during such a collapse. In this paper, we present a prescription for rescaling the component of the nuclear momentum that projects into the branching plane between arbitrary superposition states. This prescription yields accurate branching ratios and phase-space distributions when compared to alternative methods in which scaling is performed in the nonadiabatic coupling direction or the momentum direction. We justify this direction by deriving an effective nonadiabatic coupling vector from the localized Pechukas force during a collapse step.

AI.tldr: TAB算法通过将核动量重标定到分支平面方向，提高了非绝热分子动力学模拟的准确性。
AI.motivation: TAB算法在稠密电子态流形中高效模拟非绝热动力学时，需要解决塌缩过程中的能量守恒问题，即如何调整核动量。
AI.method: 提出将核动量重标定到任意叠加态之间分支平面投影分量的方案，并通过Pechukas力推导出有效非绝热耦合矢量来证明该方向的合理性。
AI.result: 与在非绝热耦合方向或动量方向进行标度的方法相比，该方法能产生更准确的分支比和相空间分布。
AI.conclusion: 分支平面方向是核动量重标定的正确方向，能有效提升TAB算法的精度。

title: Nuclear Quantum Effects as a Denoising Problem
summary: Nuclear quantum effects are rigorously captured by imaginary-time path integrals, which map the quantum Boltzmann distribution onto a ring polymer of classical replicas. Yet the nuclear masses, the coupling to the environment, and the boundary conditions of the path remain hard-wired in the simulation or the trained model, even though this quantum context enters the path measure only through a quadratic action known in closed form. Here we show that a denoiser trained on classical Boltzmann statistics alone, composed at sampling time with an analytic Gaussian component carrying the entire quantum context, yields the quantum Boltzmann distribution of the nuclei. Such a composition exists and is exact whenever the training noise does not exceed the intrinsic quantum uncertainty of the target ensemble, and it is invariant across all quantum contexts admitted by this bound. We show exact transfer across temperature, isotopic mass, dissipation strength, and the boundary conditions of the path in theory and in numerical experiments, without retraining. The last yields the end-to-end displacement and momentum distributions of a tagged nucleus from open imaginary-time paths. The same invariance extends in principle to the permuted boundary conditions of bosonic exchange, with the identical denoiser. In this view, the noise of generative modeling and the quantum fluctuations of the nuclei are two faces of the same quadratic structure.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，仅在经典玻尔兹曼统计上训练的降噪器，在采样时与携带量子语境的分析高斯分量组合，即可精确生成原子核的量子玻尔兹曼分布，实现温度、同位素质量、耗散强度和路径边界条件等量子语境的无重训练迁移。
AI.motivation: 量子核效应（如零点能、同位素效应）的路径积分模拟中，核质量、环境耦合和边界条件等量子语境信息被硬编码在模拟或训练模型中，无法跨不同量子条件泛化。作者希望找到一种通用框架，将量子语境信息与生成模型分离，使得一个仅在经典统计上训练的模型能够通过简单的组合方式适配任意量子语境，从而避免重复训练。
AI.method: 作者从数学上证明，量子玻尔兹曼分布可以精确分解为经典玻尔兹曼分布与一个已知的高斯分量的卷积。该高斯分量由路径的二次作用量（即量子语境的全部信息）决定。训练时，降噪扩散模型仅学习经典分布；采样时，只需将经典生成结果与携带量子参数的高斯核进行组合（即添加特定量子的噪声），即可恢复目标量子分布。论文从理论上推导了该分解存在的条件（训练噪声不超过目标系综的内在量子不确定性），并证明了该组合对所有满足该界限的量子语境具有不变性。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了该方法在温度、同位素质量、耗散强度和路径边界条件等不同量子语境下的精确迁移能力，无需重新训练模型。成功获得了标记原子在开放虚时路径上的端到端位移和动量分布。该不变性在理论上同样适用于玻色子交换的置换边界条件。
AI.conclusion: 生成建模中的噪声与原子核的量子涨落共享相同的二次结构，两者本质上是同一枚硬币的两面。这一发现为高效、可迁移的量子核效应模拟开辟了新途径，使得一个经典训练的生成模型即可覆盖广泛的量子条件。

title: Hypothesis-and-Refinement Learning of Organic Structures from Multimodal Spectroscopic Data
summary: Determining molecular structures from spectroscopic data remains fundamentally challenging because the inverse problem is intrinsically underdetermined: individual spectra are sparse, low-dimensional, and encode only partial structural evidence relative to the vast space of possible molecules. We address this challenge by formulating automated structure elucidation as a scalable hypothesis-refinement paradigm that tightly integrates spectral evidence with large-scale molecular priors. To supply structure-resolving NMR signals for multimodal learning, we construct \textbf{QM9SPIN}, a DFT-derived dataset comprising diverse 1D and 2D spectra, including J-coupling, DEPT experiments, and explicit spin--spin interactions. On this foundation, we introduce \textbf{SpectroMol}, a spectrum-to-structure model that proposes chemically valid molecular hypotheses conditioned on multimodal spectral inputs. Complementarily, we develop \textbf{MS-Mol2Mol}, a high-resolution mass-constrained molecular generator that integrates molecular formula, exact mass, and degree of unsaturation within a conditional generative prior trained on 400 million molecules, ensuring global compositional consistency and chemically realistic refinement. The integrated system achieves 93.8\% top-1 accuracy on the simulated benchmark, adapts effectively from simulated to experimental spectra with limited experimental fine-tuning, and further improves experimental predictions through mass-guided refinement, establishing a scalable route toward automated, data-driven organic structure elucidation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将光谱证据与大规模分子先验相结合的可扩展假设修正范式，通过构建QM9SPIN数据集和SpectroMol模型，以及MS-Mol2Mol质量约束生成器，在模拟基准上达到93.8%的top-1准确率，并实现了从模拟到实验光谱的有效迁移。
AI.motivation: 分子结构解析的根本挑战在于逆问题本质上是不适定的：单个光谱是稀疏、低维的，相对于巨大的分子空间仅编码了部分结构信息。
AI.method: 1) 构建QM9SPIN数据集，包含DFT导出的1D/2D光谱（J耦合、DEPT实验、自旋-自旋相互作用）；2) 提出SpectroMol模型，基于多模态光谱输入生成化学有效的分子假设；3) 开发MS-Mol2Mol，一种高分辨率质谱约束的分子生成器，在4亿分子上训练，整合分子式、精确质量和不饱和度。
AI.result: 在模拟基准上达到93.8%的top-1准确率，能有效从模拟光谱适应到实验光谱（仅需少量实验微调），通过质量引导的修正进一步提升实验预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 该集成系统建立了一条可扩展的、数据驱动的自动化有机结构解析路线。

title: Quantum geometry and critical temperature enhancement in MgB$_2$ superconductivity
summary: MgB$_2$, a phonon-mediated superconductor with record-high critical temperature $T_c\simeq 39$ K, is revisited to obtain a comprehensive theory of electrons, phonons, and their coupling with minimal ab initio input. We construct compact analytic models for the electronic structure, phonons, and electron-phonon coupling (EPC) of MgB$_2$. We show that strong in-plane B $sp^2$ bonding realizes an obstructed band structure whose natural description is a bond-centered kagome lattice, yielding small quasi-2D $σ$-band Fermi-surface cylinders and pronounced quantum-geometric effects. The phonon spectrum is found to closely track that of a graphene-like boron layer, but the heavy intercalated Mg atoms dominate the three acoustic branches and rigidly lift the boron modes into the optical sector, while the in-plane B-B bond-stretching mode exhibits a pronounced softening along $Γ$-A. By symmetry, this $Γ$-point bond-stretching mode is the only $Γ$ phonon that can couple to the $σ$ Fermi surface, explaining its dominant contribution to the EPC. Upon electron doping toward the doubly degenerate band edge of the $σ$ sheets, we find that a reduced density of states competes with enhanced EPC matrix elements. At light electron doping, ab initio calculations show that the EPC enhancement dominates, leading to an increase in $T_c$ (within the clean doping limit without disorder effects). Using the Gaussian approximation for the EPC tensor, we further show that this enhancement is overwhelmingly quantum geometric in origin, arising from a geometric EPC contribution of the small $σ$ Fermi surface peaked at $Γ$. Overall, our results provide a transparent, symmetry-based account of superconductivity in MgB$_2$ and suggest that quantum-geometric effects can be essential for shaping doping trends in phonon-mediated superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了MgB₂超导体，构建了电子结构、声子和电子-声子耦合的紧凑解析模型。发现强面内B sp²键合实现了受阻能带结构，可用键中心Kagome晶格自然描述。声子谱类似石墨烯硼层，但Mg原子主导声学支并刚性抬升硼光学模。对称性分析指出Γ点键伸缩模是唯一能耦合σ费米面的Γ声子，解释了其对EPC的主导贡献。电子掺杂时，EPC增强由量子几何效应主导，可提升Tc。
AI.motivation: MgB₂具有破纪录的39 K超导转变温度，但其电子-声子耦合的微观机制尚未完全清晰。本文旨在以最简化的第一性原理输入，构建MgB₂中电子、声子及其耦合的全面理论，特别是揭示量子几何效应在其中的作用。
AI.method: 构建了电子结构、声子和EPC的紧凑解析模型：采用键中心Kagome晶格描述受阻能带结构；分析声子谱的石墨烯类比及Mg原子作用；通过对称性分析筛选关键耦合模；进行电子掺杂下的ab initio计算；利用高斯近似分解EPC张量以分离量子几何贡献。
AI.result: 1) σ带费米面为准2D小圆柱，具有显著的量子几何效应；2) 面内B-B键伸缩模沿Γ-A方向显著软化；3) Γ点键伸缩模是唯一能耦合σ费米面的Γ声子；4) 轻电子掺杂下EPC增强占优，可提升Tc；5) EPC增强主要来源于量子几何效应，在Γ点达到峰值。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了MgB₂超导电性的透明、基于对称性的解释，并表明量子几何效应对声子超导体的掺杂趋势具有关键作用，为理解和发展新型高温超导体提供了新视角。

title: Dynamical and Optimization Trade-offs of Levi--Civita Coordinates for Learned Close-Encounter Dynamics
summary: Classical regularization removes the binary-collision singularity from the Kepler problem, but its value as a representation for learned Hamiltonian dynamics has not been systematically isolated. We compare Cartesian and planar Levi--Civita formulations of a perturbed Kepler system with a smooth quadrupole potential. With the perturbation supplied analytically, a Levi--Civita Hamiltonian splitting holds the maximum relative energy error near $2.1\times10^{-5}$ through eccentricity $e=0.99$, while the Cartesian splitting becomes unstable. This advantage persists at matched physical horizon and force-evaluation budget, where the regularized baseline is $3\times10^{-5}$, about $4.7$--$8.3$ orders of magnitude below the Cartesian arm depending on eccentricity. In held-out high-eccentricity tests with matched sampling, regularized models produce finite rollouts in $40/40$ runs versus $0/40$ for Cartesian. However, the fixed-shell construction supplies the regularized model with the exact initial orbit energy, and survival still carries $\mathcal{O}(1)$ energy error. Four neural residual objectives fail to approach the analytic result. Exact-feature controls show that the regularized residual is a four-monomial degree-6 polynomial that a direct least-squares solve fits to the baseline. The remaining exact-feature gap is due to severe raw-basis ill-conditioning: orthogonalization restores baseline fitting for L-BFGS in two iterations. Small MLPs remain at $\mathcal{O}(1)$ rollout error even after gauge symmetrization. Levi--Civita coordinates therefore improve dynamical conditioning while worsening raw-basis optimization conditioning; accurate neural residual learning remains unresolved. This is a controlled falsification-plus-trade-off study, not a solution to learned close-encounter dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了笛卡尔坐标与Levi-Civita正则化坐标在扰动Kepler问题（光滑四极势）中的哈密顿动力学学习表现。正则化在极高偏心率（e=0.99）下能量误差低至2.1×10⁻⁵，稳定性远超笛卡尔（后者在高偏心率下完全失效）。但正则化残差学习面临严重原始基病态条件问题，小MLP即使对称化后仍存在O(1) rollout误差。这是一项受控的证伪加权衡研究，而非学习问题解决方案。
AI.motivation: 经典正则化已解决Kepler二体奇异性的数值问题，但其作为学习哈密顿动力学表示的价值尚未被系统孤立研究。本文旨在定量评估Levi-Civita正则化在高偏心率扰动Kepler系统中对神经哈密顿模型学习的实际效益与权衡。
AI.method: 对比笛卡尔与Levi-Civita两种坐标形式下的哈密顿分裂方法，在光滑四极势扰动下进行数值实验。采用固定壳构造提供精确轨道能量，测试四种神经残差目标（均未达到解析基线）。通过精确特征控制、最小二乘拟合、正交化预处理及小MLP（含规范对称化）进行消融分析。
AI.result: 正则化在e=0.99时能量误差~2.1×10⁻⁵，笛卡尔不稳定。匹配计算预算下，正则化基线3×10⁻⁵，比笛卡尔低4.7-8.3个数量级。高偏心率外推测试：正则化40/40成功rollout，笛卡尔0/40。但神经残差学习均未接近解析结果；直接最小二乘拟合可恢复基线，但原始基严重病态；正交化后L-BFGS仅需两次迭代恢复。小MLP即使规范对称化后仍呈O(1) rollout误差。
AI.conclusion: Levi-Civita坐标改善了动力学条件性但恶化了原始基优化条件性；准确的神经残差学习仍未解决。本文是一项受控的证伪加权衡研究，而非学习问题的解决方案。

title: Markov state models revisited: Principles and algorithms for unbiased observables
summary: Markov state models (MSMs) have become ubiquitous tools for analyzing molecular dynamics (MD) simulations because of their simple, powerful premise: although complete MD sampling may be impossible, the MSM can "stitch together" transition probabilities derived from local sampling to provide a global picture of kinetics and mechanisms. In the standard MSM framework, the available MD data is organized into a single transition matrix, which is then used to estimate all observables at a lag time chosen so the coarse-grained dynamics are approximately Markovian. This approach leads to avoidable model bias and motivates long lag times that obscure short-timescale processes of interest. In contrast, this paper shows how to obtain unbiased coarse-grained observables at any fixed lag time and for any fixed coarse-graining in the limit of infinite, properly weighted data. The central idea is to replace the single-matrix framework with two transition matrices -- one representing equilibrium dynamics and another representing source-sink recycling dynamics -- and use the correct matrix or matrices to estimate the matched dynamical observables.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用双转移矩阵替代单矩阵框架，以消除马尔可夫状态模型在固定滞后时间和固定粗粒化下的偏差，并在无限、适当加权数据下获得无偏粗粒化可观测量。
AI.motivation: 标准MSM使用单一转移矩阵导致模型偏差，且需要较长滞后时间，掩盖了短时间尺度过程。
AI.method: 提出双转移矩阵方法：一个表示平衡动力学，另一个表示源-汇循环动力学，根据匹配的动力学可观测量使用正确的矩阵。
AI.result: 在无限、适当加权数据下，可在任何固定滞后时间和粗粒化下获得无偏粗粒化可观测量。
AI.conclusion: 双矩阵框架可消除标准MSM的固有偏差，保留短时间尺度动力学信息。

title: Quantum Mott semimetal in a one-dimensional Hubbard mode
summary: Mott physics in topological bands has recently attracted considerable attention, particularly in the context of twisted bilayer graphene (TBG). However, the essential ingredients for stabilizing this physics remain unclear. Here, we demonstrate a quantum Mott semimetal phase as the ground state within a one-dimensional spinful Hubbard model featuring only one orbital per unit cell, protected by inversion and particle-hole symmetries. We start from a two-orbital model where a localized $f$ orbital on the A sublattice hybridizes with a delocalized $c$ orbital on the B sublattice. Projecting the $f$-orbital Hubbard $U$ onto the active flat band yields a lattice model with Wannier orbitals centered on the B sublattice. Similar to TBG, a momentum-space scale $k_*$ emerges, setting the interaction range in the projected model to $1/k_*$. While the ground state is ferromagnetic with only the Hubbard $U$, introducing an inter-site antiferromagnetic spin coupling $J$ stabilizes a Mott semimetal$^*$ phase with a central charge $c=3$. Using exact diagonalization (ED) and density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) methods, we show that this phase hosts a spinful Dirac fermion coexisting with a neutral spin mode -- analogous to the fractionalized Fermi liquid (FL$^*$) phase in higher dimensions. Furthermore, breaking particle-hole (PH) symmetry via dispersion transforms the Mott semimetal into a Mott insulator, which is separated from a distinct Mott insulating phase by a continuous transition with a polarization jump of $1/2$. Our work provides the first unbiased evidence of a Mott semimetal ground state and demonstrates that this 1D model captures some essential aspects of TBG physics, despite lacking a Wannier obstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文在一维自旋Hubbard模型中发现了量子Mott半金属基态，该相具有中心荷c=3，包含自旋Dirac费米子与中性自旋模共存，类似高维中的分数化费米液体(FL*)。通过精确对角化和DMRG方法，展示了该相与铁磁态、Mott绝缘体之间的相变行为，并指出该一维模型虽无Wannier阻塞，但捕捉了扭曲双层石墨烯(TBG)的核心物理。
AI.motivation: 理解拓扑能带中Mott物理的稳定机制，特别是扭曲双层石墨烯(TBG)中Mott绝缘态和奇异金属态的本质，寻找更简单的模型来捕获其核心物理。
AI.method: 从双轨道模型出发（A子格局域f轨道与B子格非局域c轨道杂化），将f轨道Hubbard U投影到平带上，得到一维晶格模型。引入位点间反铁磁自旋耦合J，使用精确对角化(ED)和密度矩阵重整化群(DMRG)方法进行数值求解。
AI.result: 1) 仅有Hubbard U时基态为铁磁态；2) 引入反铁磁耦合J后，稳定了中心荷c=3的Mott半金属相，该相包含自旋Dirac费米子和中性自旋模，类似于FL*相；3) 打破粒子-空穴对称性后，Mott半金属转变为Mott绝缘体，与之不同的Mott绝缘相之间通过极化跳跃1/2的连续相变分离。
AI.conclusion: 首次提供了Mott半金属基态的无偏证据，证明该一维模型虽无Wannier阻塞，但能捕获TBG的若干核心物理特征，为理解拓扑平带系统中的强关联物理提供了新视角和简化框架。

title: Electron-Induced Formation of C$_{2}$ on Si(100) from Acetylene and Ethylene
comment: Manuscript is pages 1-25, 8 Figures. Supplementary Information is pages 24-35, with 15 Figures
summary: Hydrogen Desorption Lithography on Si(100) demonstrates the ability of the Scanning Tunneling Microscope (STM) to create functional atomic-scale structures and devices. The dehydrogenation of adsorbed molecules represents a potential complementary technique that has received little attention. For example, formation of C$_{2}$ could introduce local strain or act as centers for subsequent reactions and would inform positionally controlled mechanosynthesis, an approach with vast potential in surface patterning and functionalization. Here, we studied the electron-induced dehydrogenation of acetylene and ethylene on Si(100) at 4 K using STM. Excitation of acetylene at +3.2 V and above induces configurational switching, including to a new sublayer-bonded geometry previously predicted to be an adsorption precursor, as well as migration and desorption. Excitation also induces dehydrogenation to C$_{2}$. Switching between three observed C$_{2}$ configurations can be induced by excitation at +4.2 V and above. Simulations using density functional theory reproduced the experimental images based on choice of functional, dimer-buckling averaging, and inclusion of diffuse basis functions. In addition, dehydrogenation could be induced using field-emitted electrons on a scale ranging from a single molecule to a radius of >10 nm. These observations highlight the potential of carbon dehydrogenation as an additional tool in Atomically Precise Fabrication (APF).

AI.tldr: 本文利用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）研究了Si(100)表面上乙炔和乙烯在4K下的电子诱导脱氢反应，成功实现了C₂结构的形成与构型调控，并展示了从单分子到10 nm以上尺度的可控脱氢，为原子级精确制造提供了新工具。
AI.motivation: 现有氢脱附光刻技术已能构建原子尺度结构，但吸附分子的脱氢反应作为互补技术尚未得到充分研究。C₂结构的形成可引入局域应变或作为后续反应中心，对位置可控的机械合成和表面图案化具有重要意义。
AI.method: 在4K低温下利用STM对Si(100)表面的乙炔和乙烯进行电子激发，结合密度泛函理论（DFT）模拟验证实验图像，并通过场发射电子实现从单分子到>10 nm范围的脱氢控制。
AI.result: 1) 乙炔在+3.2 V以上激发可诱导构型切换（包括亚层键合的新几何构型）、迁移和脱氢生成C₂；2) +4.2 V以上激发可在三种C₂构型间切换；3) DFT模拟通过选择泛函、二聚体弯曲平均和弥散基组成功复现实验图像；4) 场发射电子可实现单分子至>10 nm尺度的可控脱氢。
AI.conclusion: 碳脱氢反应可作为原子级精确制造（APF）中的补充工具，拓展了STM在表面图案化和功能化中的应用潜力。

title: Chiral Magnetic Conductivity in the Tight-Binding Model of Dirac Semimetals
summary: We consider the typical tight - binding model of Dirac semimetal in the presence of both magnetic and electric fields. The electric conductivity reveals dependence on magnetic field. We calculate this dependence in the limit of strong magnetic field, when the given model is described effectively by the one - dimensional SSH model because the dynamics in the plane orthogonal to magnetic field is reduced to that of the lowest Landau level (LLL). Considering the small temperature limit we take into account dissipation due to scattering on impurities. The corresponding dissipation rate is calculated explicitly. The obtained results confirm that the source of the magnetoconductivity in this system is chiral magnetic effect.

AI.tldr: 本文在强磁场极限下将狄拉克半金属的紧束缚模型约化为一维SSH模型，通过考虑杂质散射引起的耗散，计算了电导率对磁场的依赖关系，证实了手征磁效应是磁电导率的来源。
AI.motivation: 探究狄拉克半金属在电磁场共同作用下的电导率对磁场的依赖关系，并验证手征磁效应是否为磁电导率的来源。
AI.method: 采用狄拉克半金属的紧束缚模型，在强磁场极限下将垂直于磁场的动力学约化为最低朗道能级（LLL），从而将系统有效描述为一维SSH模型；考虑低温下杂质散射引起的耗散，并显式计算耗散率。
AI.result: 成功计算了强磁场极限下电导率对磁场的依赖关系，得到了杂质散射耗散率的显式表达式。
AI.conclusion: 确认了该系统中磁电导率的来源是手征磁效应。

title: Spin-Consistency Constraints in Noncollinear Tensor TDA
summary: TDDFT for open-shell systems, whether spin-conserving or spin-flip, has long suffered from spin contamination. This problem arises because the single-excitation space built upon a single Kohn-Sham determinant is not spin-complete. Adopting spin tensor reference states therefore offers an elegant and promising route to resolving this issue. In this work, we revisit the tensor TDDFT equations within the Tamm-Dancoff approximation (TDA) from a noncollinear perspective. We show that, for S = 1/2 reference states, the internal consistency of the spin tensor formulation can, with the aid of the zero-excitation-energy theorem, be recast as a set of constraints that the exchange-correlation kernel must satisfy. Standard noncollinear functionals, however, generally fail to meet these constraints. To address this, we propose a kernel reconstruction scheme that is independent of the specific functional form and free of empirical parameters. This scheme enforces the required constraints, restoring internal consistency in the full spin tensor structure, with spin adaptation following as a natural consequence. Furthermore, when extended to tensor reference states with other values of S, such as S = 1 for the oxygen molecule, the scheme eliminates the so-called artifact states, namely solutions with severely underestimated excitation energies. In addition, the scheme allows the target states that ROKS reference states aim to describe to be expressed and computed, at the TDA level, within the same unified framework as other states, a capability that spin-adapted spin-conserving TDDFT has so far lacked.

AI.tldr: 本文针对开放壳层体系TDDFT的自旋污染问题，提出了一种不依赖具体泛函形式、无经验参数的自旋张量核重构方案，在Tamm-Dancoff近似下恢复了自旋张量形式的内在一致性，消除了人工态，并统一了ROKS参考态的激发计算框架。
AI.motivation: 开放壳层体系的TDDFT（无论是自旋守恒还是自旋翻转）长期受自旋污染困扰，根源在于基于单个Kohn-Sham行列式的单激发空间不自旋完备。采用自旋张量参考态是解决该问题的有前景的途径。
AI.method: 从非共线视角重新审视Tamm-Dancoff近似（TDA）下的张量TDDFT方程。对于S=1/2参考态，借助零激发能定理将自旋张量形式的内在一致性转化为交换相关核必须满足的约束条件。提出一种与具体泛函形式无关、无经验参数的核重构方案，强制满足这些约束，恢复完整自旋张量结构的内在一致性，自旋适应作为自然结果。方案可推广至其他S值的张量参考态（如氧分子的S=1）。
AI.result: 标准非共线泛函通常无法满足自旋张量形式所需的约束条件。所提出的核重构方案恢复了内在一致性，消除了人工态（激发能严重低估的解），并使ROKS参考态的目标态能在统一框架下表达和计算。
AI.conclusion: 该核重构方案有效解决了开放壳层TDDFT的自旋污染和人工态问题，为自旋适应TDDFT提供了统一且无经验参数的理论框架。

title: Power-Law Suppression of Superfluid Stiffness in High-Kinetic-Inductance NbN Films
summary: Disorder is a powerful route to high kinetic inductance in superconducting ultrathin films, enabling compact high-impedance quantum circuits. This functionality, however, comes at the cost of reduced phase rigidity and potentially anomalous electrodynamics. Here, we use NbN microwave resonators with thicknesses down to 2.8 nm and sheet kinetic inductance up to 300 pH per square to probe how this trade-off reshapes the superconducting response. In the thinnest films, transport shows signatures of a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition, while the microwave response reveals a pronounced low-temperature power-law suppression of the superfluid stiffness, inconsistent with Mattis-Bardeen theory. With increasing thickness, this anomalous regime is progressively suppressed, marking a continuous crossover toward conventional, gap-dominated electrodynamics. Cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy reveals a nanocrystalline twin-domain structure, pointing to oriented microstructural disorder as a crucial factor in the observed response. Overall, the crossover is governed by the ratio of superfluid stiffness to pairing energy, Theta(0)/Tc, identifying this ratio as a parameter governing the boundary between phase-fluctuation-dominated and gap-dominated superconducting electrodynamics in disordered nanofilms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了超薄NbN薄膜中无序诱导的高动能电感与超导电动力学之间的权衡，发现超流刚度与配对能量之比Θ(0)/Tc是决定相涨落主导与能隙主导超导电动力学之间交叉的关键参数。
AI.motivation: 无序可以产生高动能电感，有助于构建紧凑的高阻抗量子电路，但同时会降低相位刚性并可能导致异常电动力学。本文旨在探究这种权衡如何重塑超导响应。
AI.method: 使用厚度低至2.8 nm、片动能电感高达300 pH/□的NbN微波谐振器，结合输运测量、微波响应表征以及横截面透射电子显微镜分析。
AI.result: 最薄薄膜中观察到BKT转变迹象，微波响应显示超流刚度在低温下呈幂律抑制，与Mattis-Bardeen理论不符；随厚度增加逐渐过渡到常规电动力学；微观结构呈现纳米晶孪晶畴结构。
AI.conclusion: Θ(0)/Tc是描述无序纳米薄膜中超导电动力学从相涨落主导到能隙主导交叉的控制参数，取向微结构无序是关键因素。

title: Bayesian Inference: Kernel-Based Model for Surface Temperature Reconstruction in Ice Borehole Thermometry
summary: Reconstructing past surface temperature from shallow ice borehole temperature profiles requires solving an ill-posed inverse problem while quantifying uncertainties arising from measurements and prior assumptions. Bayesian formulations enable probabilistic reconstruction of surface temperature histories and uncertainty quantification. Existing reversible jump-Markov chain Monte Carlo approach based on adaptive piecewise-linear surface temperature models can, however, be computationally demanding. Here, we introduce a kernel-based surface temperature model that enables the use of a parallel ensemble Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler for efficient exploration of the solution space and quantification of the posterior. Using synthetic experiments, we investigate the effects of kernel configuration, measurement uncertainty, measurement density, and temporal smearing on reconstruction performance. We find that reconstruction quality is largely insensitive to the number of kernels once the kernel basis is sufficiently dense. Reducing measurement uncertainty substantially improves reconstructions, whereas increasing the number of borehole temperature measurements provides only marginal benefit. Finally, we evaluate the method using realistic surrogate climate histories that combine long-term temperature changes with stochastic climate variability. The kernel-based surface temperature model cannot represent short-term variability and therefore cannot fully explain the realistic measurements, highlighting the need to account for this approximation uncertainty. The likelihood is adapted to include the approximation uncertainty of the surface temperature model, yielding robust reconstructions with reliable posterior uncertainties. Overall, our results demonstrate that kernel-based Bayesian inversion provides an efficient framework for shallow ice borehole based climate reconstructions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于核函数的浅层冰钻孔温度反演方法，利用并行集成MCMC采样器高效重建地表温度历史并量化不确定性。实验表明该方法对核数量不敏感，降低测量误差显著改善重建质量，而增加测量点收益有限。通过引入近似不确定性修正似然函数，该方法能稳健处理真实气候序列中的短期变异性。
AI.motivation: 浅层冰钻孔温度反演是一个病态逆问题，现有基于可逆跳转MCMC的自适应分段线性方法计算代价高昂，亟需一种计算高效且能可靠量化不确定性的方法。
AI.method: 引入基于核函数的地表温度模型，配合并行集成马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样器进行解空间探索和后验量化；并通过修改似然函数纳入地表温度模型的近似不确定性。
AI.result: 重建质量对核数量不敏感（核基足够密时）；降低测量不确定性显著改善重建，增加测量点仅有边际收益；该方法无法表示短期气候变异性，但通过修正似然函数包含近似不确定性后，能获得稳健的重建结果和可靠的后验不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 基于核函数的贝叶斯反演为浅层冰钻孔气候重建提供了一个高效且稳健的框架。

title: Localization transitions of diffusion dynamics in physical networks
summary: Network diffusion underlies many transport phenomena, with Laplacian modes setting how information spreads and relaxes. In physical networks, however, connectivity alone is not enough: node volumes introduce local dwell times that regulate how flow is stored before being propagated. Here we show that physical heterogeneity reshapes topology-driven localization, with the degree-volume ratio emerging as the relevant disorder parameter. We solve an analytical model in which ratio detuning qualitatively reorganizes the Laplacian spectrum, and demonstrate in empirical networks how degree-volume correlations shift extremal eigenmodes away from the nodes selected by topology alone. Our results reveal a general feature-rich-driven mechanism for localization control, showing that physicality non-trivially reshapes the disorder landscape governing network dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究物理网络（如血管、电网）中节点体积对拉普拉斯动力学的影响，发现度数-体积比是新的无序参数，它重塑了拓扑驱动的局域化模式，并通过解析模型和实证网络验证了物理异质性如何改变特征模态的分布。
AI.motivation: 传统网络扩散理论仅关注拓扑连接性，但实际物理网络中节点体积会引入局部停留时间，影响流量存储与传播。作者旨在揭示物理异质性如何改变拓扑驱动的局域化行为，并识别关键控制参数。
AI.method: 解析建模度数-体积比率失调对拉普拉斯谱的定性重组，并在实证物理网络中验证度数-体积相关性如何使极端特征模态偏离纯拓扑选择的节点。
AI.result: 度数-体积比是调控局域化的关键无序参数；度数-体积相关性会显著改变拉普拉斯算子的极端特征模态，使其从拓扑主导的节点偏移；物理性非平凡地重塑了网络动力学的无序景观。
AI.conclusion: 物理异质性为局域化控制提供了超越纯拓扑的丰富机制，表明在设计或理解网络传输功能时，必须同时考虑拓扑与节点体积的耦合效应。

title: Anyon Crystals and Hall Crystals in a Periodic Potential
summary: We obtain integer and fractional quantum Hall crystals as ground states of a two-dimensional electron system subject to a strong perpendicular magnetic field and a periodic potential. For certain fractional states, we show that the Hall crystal can constitute an anyon crystal, with a periodic ordering of well-defined anyons. We find that the latter states can be stabilized at odd denominator Landau level filling fractions when Landau level mixing is sufficiently weak, and near half-filling of the underlying lattice. These phases are obtained from a mean-field analysis of an effective lattice model of bosons attached to an odd number of flux quanta, which transmutes their statistics to that of electrons. In boson coordinates, the Hall crystal is a supersolid: a superfluid with charge order. Under strong interactions, vortex-anti-vortex pairs spontaneously nucleate in the supersolid, realizing a crystalline state of anyons.

AI.tldr: 本文通过平均场分析，发现二维电子系统在强垂直磁场和周期势下，可以形成整数和分数量子霍尔晶体。在特定的分数量子霍尔态中，霍尔晶体可以表现为任意子晶体，即具有明确定义的任意子周期性排序。这些态在朗道能级混合足够弱且晶格接近半填充时稳定存在。
AI.motivation: 探索在强磁场和周期势共同作用下二维电子系统的新奇量子相，特别是任意子晶体的存在可能性。
AI.method: 将电子通过通量附着转化为玻色子（统计转变），构建有效晶格模型，采用平均场分析研究基态性质。
AI.result: 发现整数和分数量子霍尔晶体可作为基态存在；分数量子霍尔态中可形成任意子晶体；在玻色子坐标下霍尔晶体是一种超固体（超流+电荷序）；强相互作用下超固体中自发核化出涡旋-反涡旋对，实现任意子晶体。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了霍尔晶体与任意子晶体的深刻联系，为在实验系统中实现和操控任意子晶体提供了理论依据。

title: Photoemission from Semi-Infinite Crystals: An \emph{Ab Initio} Scattering-State Approach
summary: Photoemission is an escape problem, yet first-principles calculations usually trap the electron in a periodic box. We present a parameter-free \emph{ab initio} framework that removes this artificial boundary by constructing open scattering states for semi-infinite crystal-vacuum interfaces from Wannier Hamiltonians and Green-function embedding. The method gives continuum-normalized time-reversed LEED final states with microscopic quasiparticle attenuation. For Ag(111), it predicts absolute quantum efficiency, vectorial photoemission, and mean transverse energy on the experimental scale.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种无参数的第一性原理框架，通过构建半无限晶体-真空界面的开放散射态，解决了传统光发射计算中周期性边界条件带来的电子束缚问题，并在Ag(111)表面实现了与实验一致的绝对量子效率、矢量光电子发射和平均横向能量预测。
AI.motivation: 传统第一性原理计算将电子束缚在周期性盒子中，无法真实描述光电子发射过程中的逃逸问题，导致计算结果与实验存在偏差。
AI.method: 基于Wannier哈密顿量和Green函数嵌入方法，构建半无限晶体-真空界面的开放散射态，得到连续归一化、包含微观准粒子衰减的时间反演LEED末态。
AI.result: 在Ag(111)表面，该方法成功预测了绝对量子效率、矢量光电子发射和平均横向能量，且数值与实验测量结果吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该无参数第一性原理框架有效消除了人工边界效应，为光电子发射过程的精确从头计算提供了可行方案。

title: Coupled-channel approach to scattering of hybrid excitons
summary: We consider the interactions of hybrid excitons in a two-dimensional semiconductor bilayer, where spatially direct and indirect excitons are hybridized by interlayer charge-carrier tunneling. Starting from a microscopic electron-hole description, we construct realistic pseudopotentials for exciton-exciton interactions and use them as inputs to a coupled-channel scattering integral equation. This enables non-perturbative calculations of hybrid-exciton scattering beyond standard perturbative theories, and highlights the importance of energy-dependent scattering and channel mixing. In particular, we show that the interaction strength of hybrid excitons exhibits a rapid growth with increasing energy, which we find is inherited from their indirect-exciton component. We further demonstrate that dielectric screening affects the direct and indirect channels in distinct ways, leading to markedly different interaction strengths across experimentally relevant dielectric environments. Finally, we show that the hybrid-exciton scattering strength can be electrically tuned via the Stark shift, which controls the direct-indirect detuning and hence the hybridization of the two exciton modes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微观电子-空穴描述构建了混合激子的赝势相互作用模型，利用耦合通道散射积分方程实现了非微扰计算，揭示了混合激子相互作用强度随能量快速增长、介电屏蔽对直接与间接通道的差异化影响，以及通过斯塔克位移实现电学调控混合激子散射强度的机制。
AI.motivation: 标准微扰理论无法准确描述混合激子间的相互作用，特别是在能量依赖散射和通道混合效应显著的场景下，需要发展非微扰计算方法。
AI.method: 从微观电子-空穴描述出发，构建激子-激子相互作用的现实赝势，将其输入耦合通道散射积分方程进行非微扰计算。
AI.result: (1) 混合激子相互作用强度随能量快速增长，这一特性继承自间接激子组分；(2) 介电屏蔽对直接和间接通道有差异化影响；(3) 可通过斯塔克位移电学调控混合激子的散射强度。
AI.conclusion: 混合激子散射存在显著的通道混合与能量依赖效应，且其相互作用强度可通过介电环境和电场进行灵活调控，为激子物理和器件应用提供了新思路。

title: Rem3Di: Learning smooth, chiral 3D molecular descriptors from atomistic foundation models
comment: An earlier version of this work appeared at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps). Workshop version: https://openreview.net/forum?id=jOmZsvXoK5
summary: Foundation machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are trained on large quantum-mechanical datasets and generalise across broad regions of chemical and configurational space. Beyond their usual role in accelerating sampling-based simulations, their internal representations encode chemically rich local atomic environments. Here, we introduce Rem3Di, a representation-learning framework that repurposes latent features from atomistic foundation models as transferable molecular descriptors for property prediction and virtual screening. Rem3Di combines a potential's per-atom features into a single fixed-length descriptor of the whole molecule that varies smoothly with three-dimensional structure and is invariant to the ordering of the atoms. The descriptor can be used directly or fine-tuned for specific prediction tasks. To capture molecular handedness, Rem3Di constructs pseudoscalar features, which are unchanged by rotation but reverse sign under mirror reflection. This lets the descriptor distinguish enantiomers, which can differ in activity and toxicity. The transformer is pretrained on large molecular datasets by reconstructing corrupted atom features, so no experimental labels are required. Across public drug-property benchmarks, Rem3Di matches or exceeds published baselines without relying on classical 2D fingerprints. Additionally, the same descriptor yields chemically meaningful differentiation of transition-metal complexes without predefined bonding rules or handcrafted representations. Rem3Di therefore provides a route from simulation-trained atomistic representations to transferable, chirality-aware molecular representations for chemical machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Rem3Di框架，利用原子级基础机器学习势能模型的潜在特征，构建可迁移、等变、手性感知的分子描述符，用于性质预测和虚拟筛选，在药物性质和过渡金属配合物任务上达到或超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 传统分子描述符多依赖2D指纹或手工特征，缺乏对三维结构和手性的感知；而基础MLIP虽能编码丰富化学环境，但尚未被系统用于分子级表示学习。Rem3Di旨在填补这一空白，将模拟训练的原子表示转化为通用的分子描述符。
AI.method: 从预训练的原子间势模型提取每个原子的潜在特征，通过等变聚合得到固定长度的分子级描述符。引入赝标量特征以区分对映体，并使用Transformer在大规模分子数据集上进行自监督预训练（重构被破坏的原子特征），无需实验标签。
AI.result: 在公开药物性质基准上，Rem3Di匹配或超越了现有基线方法，且不依赖传统2D指纹；在过渡金属配合物任务上，无需预定义键规则即可实现化学有意义的区分。
AI.conclusion: Rem3Di提供了一条从模拟训练的原子表示到可迁移、手性感知的分子表示的有效路径，对药物筛选和材料设计具有重要价值。

title: Stacking-tuned superconductivity and competing charge-density-wave states in NbSe$_2$
summary: Layer stacking provides a powerful yet underexplored route for reshaping collective quantum order in van der Waals materials. Here we use high-resolution scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy to show that the stacking sequence alone can qualitatively transform the charge density and superconducting orders in NbSe$_2$, while preserving the same in-plane atomic structure. Comparing the 4Ha and 2H polytypes, we find that, unlike the ubiquitous triangular incommensurate $3Q^\mathrm{I}$ order of 2H-NbSe$_2$, 4Ha-NbSe$_2$ hosts two competing CDW states with no measurable correlation with local strain: a unidirectional commensurate $1Q^\mathrm{C}$ phase and a triangular incommensurate $3Q^\mathrm{I}$ phase, with $Q^\mathrm{I}=Q^\mathrm{C}+δ$. We introduce a phase-resolved analysis that directly maps the gradient of the CDW phases and reveals vortices bound to the $1Q^\mathrm{C}$ - $3Q^\mathrm{I}$ phase boundaries. These vortices accommodate the momentum mismatch $δ$ through abrupt $2π$ phase slips, providing a mechanism by which distinct charge orders coexist. Superconductivity is also reshaped by stacking, while both polytypes exhibit multiband pairing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了NbSe₂中堆叠顺序如何改变电荷密度波和超导序，发现4Ha多型体存在两种竞争的CDW态，并在相边界观察到涡旋结构。
AI.motivation: 探索层状范德华材料中堆叠顺序这一尚未充分研究的途径如何重塑集体量子序。
AI.method: 使用高分辨率扫描隧道显微镜和能谱学，对比2H和4Ha两种多型体，并引入相位分辨分析方法直接映射CDW相位梯度。
AI.result: 4Ha-NbSe₂存在单向1Q^C相和三角非公度3Q^I相两种竞争CDW态，相边界处观察到位错涡旋；超导性也受堆叠影响，两种多型体均表现多带配对。
AI.conclusion: 堆叠序列可独立于面内原子结构定性改变电荷序和超导序，为调控范德华材料量子相提供新途径。

title: Reconstructing local environments from concise atomistic representations
summary: Symmetry-based representations of local atomic structure, such as the power spectrum or bispectrum, are routinely used to characterize the structural diversity of datasets and as input features for atomistic machine learning. Although these descriptors systematically incorporate increasingly complex geometric correlations, it remains unclear if a given feature can be mapped back to a discrete point cloud, whether such a reconstruction is unique, and how changes in the descriptor are reflected in the underlying atomic geometry. The choice and discretization of the radial and angular bases, as well as the high dimensionality of the resulting feature vectors -- which may contain hundreds or thousands of components -- make this interpretation even more challenging. In this work, we investigate the inverse problem of recovering atomic structures from invariant descriptors. We show that accurate reconstructions can be obtained from remarkably compact descriptors of different correlation orders, each comprising only a few tens of features. Even representations that are formally incomplete or locally ill-conditioned can be inverted to accurate geometric reconstructions of atomic environments across molecular and material datasets. Our reconstruction framework provides a general algorithmic means of identifying approximate degeneracies of invariant descriptors and recovering distinct atomic environments that cannot be distinguished by a given representation. Finally, by reconstructing atomic configurations from descriptors, we examine how perturbations in invariant descriptors of different correlation orders translate into structural distortions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了从对称性不变的原子结构描述符（如功率谱、双谱）逆向重建原子构型的问题，发现即使在特征维度较低（仅几十个特征）或描述符不完整/欠定的情况下，也能实现精确重构，并提供了识别描述符简并性及分析结构扰动的方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管对称性不变的原子结构描述符（如功率谱、双谱）被广泛用于表征原子结构多样性及作为机器学习输入特征，但尚不清楚这些特征是否能唯一地映射回离散的点云结构，描述符的变化如何在原子几何中体现，以及高维特征向量的可解释性较差。因此，本文旨在解决从不变描述符逆向恢复原子结构的逆问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种从不同关联阶数的紧凑描述符（仅几十个特征）逆向重建原子构型的算法框架。该框架能够处理形式上不完整或局部病态的描述符，并提供了识别近似简并性以及恢复无法被给定表示区分的不同原子环境的方法。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使使用维度极低的描述符，也能实现精确的原子结构重建；不完整或局部病态的描述符也可被逆向为准确的几何重建；通过重构还揭示了不同关联阶数的不变描述符扰动如何转化为结构畸变。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明从对称性不变的紧凑描述符逆向重建原子结构是可行且鲁棒的，为理解描述符的简并性、唯一性以及结构-描述符映射关系提供了通用算法工具。

title: Weakly Nonlinear Dynamics of Unstable Modes in Jammed Amorphous Solids
summary: We investigate the structural evolution in jammed amorphous solids by analyzing the eigenmodes of a generalized Hessian matrix that incorporates spatial modulation via wave numbers. Unlike the conventional Hessian, this generalized formulation captures linearly unstable modes through a Fourier-based extension of the Hessian matrix, enabling us to study responses beyond the mechanically stable regime. We demonstrate that the excitation of unstable eigenmodes leads to structural rearrangements independent of the initial perturbation by the simulation. Furthermore, we derive a weakly nonlinear amplitude equation to describe the growth and saturation of these unstable modes, analogous to the Landau equation. Our framework provides a pathway to understand instability-driven configuration changes in disordered solids.

AI.tldr: 本文通过广义Hessian矩阵的特征模态分析，研究了无定形固体在堵塞状态下的结构演化，发现不稳定模态的激发可导致与初始扰动无关的结构重排，并推导了描述不稳定模态增长与饱和的弱非线性振幅方程。
AI.motivation: 传统Hessian矩阵只能分析力学稳定体系，无法捕捉不稳定模态。本文旨在通过引入波数空间调制的广义Hessian矩阵，研究无序固体中失稳驱动的结构变化机制。
AI.method: 构建包含空间调制的广义Hessian矩阵（基于傅里叶扩展），分析其特征模态；通过模拟研究不稳定特征模态的激发与结构重排的关系；推导描述模态增长与饱和的弱非线性振幅方程（类比Landau方程）。
AI.result: 不稳定特征模态的激发会导致结构重排，且该重排与初始扰动无关；推导出的弱非线性振幅方程能够描述不稳定模态从增长到饱和的完整演化过程。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为理解无序固体中失稳驱动的构型变化提供了有效路径，拓展了传统弹性稳定性分析的范围。

title: Coloring in anyon superconductivity
summary: The recently observed signatures of superconductivity proximate to a fractional quantum anomalous Hall (FQAH) state in a twisted MoTe$_2$ bilayer has revitalized interest in quantum phases of matter induced by anyon dynamics. Here we show how a panoply of anyon-driven phases associated with doping the lattice ${ν=2/3}$ FQAH state can be realized as competing instabilities of a Fermi surface of charge-$e/3$ "quarks" coupled to a $\mathrm{SU}(3)_{-1}$ Chern-Simons gauge field, which is dual to the more conventional $\mathrm{U}(1)_3$ Chern-Simons-Ginzburg-Landau theory of quasiholes. For example, a range of electronic superconductors emerge from color superconductivity, under which the Fermi surface experiences a pairing instability mediated by gauge fluctuations. These include SC$\star$ phases -- where superconductivity coexists with topological order -- as well as topological superconductors displaying half-integer chiral central charges when the quarks are weakly paired. One example is a topological superconductor arising from a $p+ip$ "color-valley-locked" pairing mechanism with chiral central charge $c_-=-1/2$. On the other hand, both superconducting and non-Fermi liquid phases can emerge when the quarks form an itinerant ferromagnet, polarizing the Fermi surface to a particular combination of colors. Finally, our framework naturally accommodates the possibility of anyonic bound state formation, allowing access to phases induced by doping anyons of charge $2e/3$ as opposed to $e/3$ within the same model. Our work unifies many earlier proposed anyonic phases as instabilities of a single parent quark metal phase, distilling their emergence into a competition between superconductivity and itinerant color ferromagnetism.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了如何通过掺杂ν=2/3的分数量子反常霍尔（FQAH）态，在扭曲MoTe₂双层体系中实现一系列任意子驱动的量子相。这些相源于带电荷e/3的“夸克”费米面与SU(3)_{-1}陈-西蒙斯规范场的耦合不稳定性，包括与拓扑序共存的超导相（SC*）、具有半整数手征中心荷的拓扑超导体（如p+ip配对机制，c_=-1/2），以及非费米液体相。该框架统一了多种先前提出的任意子相。
AI.motivation: 近期在扭曲MoTe₂双层中观测到接近分数量子反常霍尔态的超导迹象，激发了人们研究任意子动力学诱导量子相的兴趣。作者希望阐明掺杂FQAH态时可能出现的任意子驱动相及其统一描述。
AI.method: 采用对偶理论，将传统的U(1)_3陈-西蒙斯-金兹堡-朗道理论对偶为带电荷e/3的“夸克”费米面耦合SU(3)_{-1}陈-西蒙斯规范场的描述，通过分析费米面在规范涨落下的配对不稳定性（色超导）和巡游铁磁不稳定性来研究各种竞争相。
AI.result: 预言了多种超导相：SC*相（超导与拓扑序共存）、拓扑超导体（如p+ip“色-谷锁定”配对，手征中心荷c_=-1/2）；以及超导-非费米液体相（夸克形成巡游铁磁体时）；还自然容纳了掺杂2e/3电荷任意子的可能性。
AI.conclusion: 本文统一了多种先前提出的任意子相，将其归结为一个“夸克金属”母相在超导与巡游色铁磁之间的竞争失稳，为理解扭曲MoTe₂中的超导-拓扑关联现象提供了统一的理论框架。

title: Assessing the Influence of d-Orbital Radius on the Formation of Localized Photogenerated States in Corundum Metal Oxides
summary: Photogenerated polarons are fundamental to the photophysics of transition metal oxide semiconductors. It is therefore imperative to understand the mechanisms by which polarons form upon photoexcitation of transition metal oxides to realize their potential in photoapplications. Hematite (α-Fe2O3) is known to form photoexcited small polarons, which limit its performance as a photoelectrocatalyst for water oxidation. Here, we report a systematic comparison of the electronic, optical and vibrational properties of hematite to those other metal oxides in the corundum crystal family that elucidates the impact of d-orbital radius on carrier-phonon coupling. Three corundum metal oxides are analyzed: α-Al2O3 (no d-electrons), α-Fe2O3 (3d), and α-Rh2O3 (4d) with a combined approach of resonance Raman spectroscopy, thermal difference optical spectroscopy, and computational modeling of electronic and vibrational states. We find that the Raman spectrum of α-Al2O3 does not change as the Raman excitation is varied across the visible region, as there is no optical absorption. In contrast, both α-Fe2O3 and α-Rh2O3 exhibit strong coupling of phonons to optical transitions at the onset of absorption, which is evidence of excitation into a polaronic state. Closely comparing the optical polaronic properties of α-Fe2O3 and α-Rh2O3, we establish that increased lattice covalency in α-Rh2O3 arising from the increased radial extension of the 4d orbitals influences which phonon modes mediate photogenerated polaron formation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了刚玉族金属氧化物（α-Al₂O₃、α-Fe₂O₃、α-Rh₂O₃）的电子、光学和振动性质，揭示了d轨道半径对光生极化子形成的影响。研究发现，α-Fe₂O₃（3d）和α-Rh₂O₃（4d）在吸收起始处均表现出强声子-光学跃迁耦合，证实了极化子激发态的存在；而α-Rh₂O₃中4d轨道更大的径向延伸增加了晶格共价性，从而改变了介导光生极化子形成的声子模式。
AI.motivation: 理解过渡金属氧化物中光生极化子的形成机制对于实现其光电应用至关重要。赤铁矿（α-Fe₂O₃）形成的光激发小极化子限制了其作为光电催化剂的性能，因此需要深入探究极化子形成的内在机理。
AI.method: 采用共振拉曼光谱、热差光学光谱以及电子和振动态的计算建模，系统比较了三种刚玉族金属氧化物（无d电子的α-Al₂O₃、3d轨道的α-Fe₂O₃和4d轨道的α-Rh₂O₃）的性质。
AI.result: α-Al₂O₃的拉曼光谱在可见光区不随激发波长变化；α-Fe₂O₃和α-Rh₂O₃均在吸收起始处表现出强声子-光学跃迁耦合，证实极化子激发；α-Rh₂O₃中4d轨道的更大径向延伸增加了晶格共价性，改变了参与极化子形成的声子模式。
AI.conclusion: d轨道半径大小及其导致的晶格共价性差异是影响过渡金属氧化物中光生极化子形成机制的关键因素，4d轨道体系（α-Rh₂O₃）与3d轨道体系（α-Fe₂O₃）在极化子介导的声子模式上存在显著区别。

title: Majorana bound states in anisotropic and tilted Dirac and Weyl systems
summary: Topological superconductors host Majorana boundary modes whose robustness is protected by the nontrivial topology of the bulk Bogoliubov quasiparticle spectrum. While Majorana bound states associated with Dirac and Weyl quasiparticles have been extensively investigated, much less is known about how anisotropic quasiparticle velocities and tilted band structures modify their microscopic properties. Here, we develop an analytical framework for Majorana bound states in effective two-dimensional (2D) Bogoliubov--de Gennes Dirac theories describing the surface quasiparticles of topological superconductors and extend the analysis to three-dimensional (3D) tilted Weyl systems by establishing a microscopic connection to the same low-energy description through superconducting pairing. For anisotropic 2D Dirac systems, we derive closed analytical expressions for the continuum topological invariant, Majorana wave function, localization length, propagation velocity, and finite-size minigap for arbitrary interface orientations. We show that the chirality of the Majorana channel is determined by the sign of the velocity-matrix determinant, while its localization and dispersion are governed jointly by the velocity tensor and the interface geometry. For tilted 2D Dirac cones, we demonstrate that the tilt leaves the spinor eigenstates, Berry phase, and projected pairing symmetry unchanged, but strongly suppresses the Majorana propagation velocity and finite-size minigap as the Lifshitz transition between type-I and type-II regimes is approached. Finally, we consider superconducting tilted 3D Weyl systems and show that the projection of a conventional spin-singlet $s$-wave pairing interaction onto the low-energy Weyl bands naturally generates an effective chiral $p_x\pm ip_y$ pairing symmetry, providing a microscopic Bogoliubov--de Gennes description that supports localized Majorana surface states.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了拓扑超导体中马约拉纳边界态的解析框架，系统研究了各向异性Dirac系统和倾斜Weyl系统中速度各向异性与能带倾斜对马约拉纳态微观性质的影响，推导了连续拓扑不变量、波函数、局域长度等物理量的解析表达式，并揭示了倾斜对马约拉纳传播速度和有限尺寸能隙的抑制效应。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注Dirac和Weyl准粒子相关的马约拉纳束缚态，但对各向异性准粒子速度和倾斜能带结构如何改变其微观性质了解甚少，因此需要系统研究这些因素的影响。
AI.method: 1. 针对有效二维Bogoliubov-de Gennes Dirac理论，推导了任意界面取向下的解析解；2. 通过超导配对建立三维倾斜Weyl系统与低能描述的微观联系；3. 分析了速度张量、界面几何等参数对马约拉纳态的影响。
AI.result: 1. 马约拉纳通道的手性由速度矩阵行列式符号决定；2. 局域化和色散由速度张量和界面几何共同决定；3. 倾斜不改变旋量本征态和贝里相位，但在接近Lifshitz转变时强烈抑制传播速度和有限尺寸能隙；4. 传统s波配对投影到Weyl能带可自然产生有效手性p波配对。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了各向异性和倾斜效应下马约拉纳边界态的完整解析理论框架，为理解拓扑超导体中准粒子速度各向异性对马约拉纳模式的影响提供了理论基础，并为实验观测提供了可验证的预测。

title: Investigating aqueous mineral interfaces using sum frequency generation spectroscopy
summary: Sum frequency generation spectroscopy can be utilized to address the challenge of studying solid-liquid interfaces under ambient pressure and with macroscopic amounts of liquid, while still retrieving molecular level information. By utilizing a non-linear optical process, this method allows to selectively measure vibrations of interfacial species. Within this chapter sum frequency generation spectroscopy is first briefly introduced and then comprehensively evaluated as an investigative tool for solid-liquid interfaces, with mineral-water interfaces as model system. Additionally, it is explained how the actual probing depth of this method depends on both the experimental setup and the properties of the investigated system, such as surface charges.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了和频产生（SFG）光谱作为一种非线性光学技术，用于在环境压力和宏观液体条件下研究固液界面，并获得分子级信息。以矿物-水界面为模型系统，评估了SFG作为研究工具的能力，并探讨了其探测深度如何依赖于实验设置和系统性质（如表面电荷）。
AI.motivation: 固液界面在环境压力和宏观液体存在下的分子级信息获取困难，需要一种能够选择性地测量界面物种振动的非侵入式方法。
AI.method: 采用和频产生（SFG）光谱这一非线性光学技术，利用其对界面物种振动选择性的测量能力来研究固液界面。
AI.result: SFG光谱能够有效探测固液界面的分子信息，且其探测深度受实验配置和系统性质（如表面电荷）影响。
AI.conclusion: SFG光谱是研究固液界面（特别是矿物-水界面）的有效工具，但其探测深度需根据具体实验条件和体系特性进行考量。

title: Exact static exchange benchmark for the uniform electron gas: Dynamic-kernel tests and exchange-correlation cancellation near 2kF
summary: The static local field factors of the uniform electron gas are known accurately from quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) calculations, but two of their most striking features have lacked a mechanism: $G_+$ grows almost exactly as $q^2$ up to nearly $2k_F$, and the violent $2k_F$ physics of the Fermi surface leaves only a faint trace in it. Combining the textbook first-order local-field relation with the exact static exchange polarizability gives a compact exact benchmark: the universal exchange-only local field factor $G_x(q,0) = -I(Q)Q^2/L(Q)^2$, $Q = q/2k_F$, with exact values $(1/4)(q/k_F)^2$ at small $q$, $π^2/6$ at $2k_F$ -- apparently never before stated as a local-field value -- and $1/3$ at large $q$, giving the exchange-only spin-averaged contact value $g(0) = 1/2$ of the unpolarized gas (BDL 1977). $G_x$ rises to a finite maximum of 1.9924 at $1.9685k_F$ and passes through $π^2/6$ at exactly $2k_F$ with a slope diverging as $\ln^3|q-2k_F|$. Against this benchmark, the 1980 BDL tabulation is accurate to about one percent below $1.5k_F$, while the 2024 McLachlan-variational kernel of Nazarov and Silkin is two-percent accurate only below $0.5k_F$, is a factor of 1.74 low at $2k_F$, and its large-q limit is inconsistent with the contact constraint. A spin-resolved decomposition of QMC local field factors about the exact baseline shows that, within the resolution and smoothness assumptions of the QMC-based representations, both features follow from a strong exchange-correlation cancellation: at the QMC point closest to $2k_F$ ($q = 2.01k_F$, $r_s = 2$), correlation cancels 0.43(7) of the exact exchange value 1.33. Computed consistently at each wavevector, the static exchange-kernel thresholds derived from the closed form reproduce, to 0.2%, the finite-wavevector charge threshold $r_s \approx 10.6$ near $q = 1.94k_F$ obtained numerically in 1980, and recovered again in 2014.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了均匀电子气交换仅局域场因子的精确解析表达式 $G_x(q,0) = -I(Q)Q^2/L(Q)^2$，揭示了QMC计算中两个长期未解特征（$G_+$ 在 $2k_F$ 前呈 $q^2$ 增长、费米面 $2k_F$ 物理仅留微弱痕迹）的机制：交换-关联强抵消。该基准验证了BDL(1980)表格的准确性，并指出Nazarov & Silkin(2024)变分核在 $2k_F$ 处误差显著。
AI.motivation: 均匀电子气QMC计算的静态局域场因子有两个显著特征缺乏物理解释：$G_+$ 在近 $2k_F$ 前几乎严格按 $q^2$ 增长，以及费米面的 $2k_F$ 剧烈物理效应仅留下微弱痕迹。本文旨在为这两个现象提供解析基准机制。
AI.method: 将教科书级一阶局域场关系与精确静态交换极化率结合，推导出交换仅局域场因子 $G_x(q,0) = -I(Q)Q^2/L(Q)^2$（$Q = q/2k_F$）。然后基于QMC数据，对局域场因子进行自旋分辨分解，量化交换-关联抵消效应。
AI.result: $G_x$ 在小 $q$ 为 $(1/4)(q/k_F)^2$，在 $2k_F$ 处精确为 $\pi^2/6 \approx 1.6449$（此前未见报道），大 $q$ 极限为 $1/3$，峰值 $1.9924$ 在 $1.9685k_F$，$2k_F$ 处斜率发散为 $\ln^3|q-2k_F|$。BDL(1980) 在 $1.5k_F$ 以下误差~1%，而 Nazarov & Silkin(2024) 在 $2k_F$ 处仅为真值的 $1/1.74$。在 $r_s=2$、$q=2.01k_F$ 处，关联抵消了精确交换值 $1.33$ 中的 $0.43(7)$。
AI.conclusion: 两个长期未解特征源于交换-关联强抵消效应。解析闭式可作为基准，精确复现1980年和2014年数值得到的有限波矢电荷阈值 $r_s \approx 10.6$（$q \approx 1.94k_F$），误差仅0.2%。

title: Motility destabilizes an absorbing-state flock
summary: Activity, when it takes the form of motility, is generally seen to promote order in many-body systems. Here we present a one-dimensional lattice model that, in the non-motile limit, exhibits absorbing ferromagnetic states. When activity is introduced through biased motility, these absorbing state are destabilised and the system instead undergoes a transition from an ordered flock to a disordered state as the alignment strength is decreased. A finite-size scaling analysis of physical quantities reveals a continuous transition with critical exponents satisfying the hyperscaling relation in one dimension, providing quantitative evidence for the activity-induced disorder.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一维晶格模型发现，偏向性运动（活动性）会破坏非运动极限下的铁磁有序吸收态，导致系统随对齐强度减弱而发生从有序群集到无序状态的连续相变，并满足一维超标度关系。
AI.motivation: 通常认为活动性（以运动形式）能促进多体系统的有序性，本文旨在探究活动性是否会反直觉地诱导无序，通过构建一维模型定量分析这一矛盾现象。
AI.method: 提出一维晶格模型，在非运动极限下具有铁磁吸收态；通过引入偏向性运动（活动性）破坏吸收态，改变对齐强度进行数值模拟，并采用有限尺寸标度分析物理量的临界指数。
AI.result: 活动性破坏了非运动极限下的有序吸收态；系统随对齐强度减小发生从有序群集到无序的连续相变；临界指数满足一维超标度关系，定量证实了活动性诱导的无序。
AI.conclusion: 活动性并非总促进有序，在本模型中被偏向性运动诱导出无序，且该相变为连续相变，符合一维超标度关系。

title: Optical Magnetic Switching in Odd-Parity Magnets with Spin-Orbit Coupling
comment: 5+5 pages, 11 figures, Submitted to a journal
summary: $p$-wave magnets exhibit odd-parity spin polarization in momentum space, with spin splitting that reverses under $\vec{k}\rightarrow -\vec{k}$, while preserving zero net magnetization. Here we show that, in odd-parity magnets with spin-orbit coupling, elliptically polarized light generates a momentum-independent spin-dependent term that dynamically switches a zero-net-magnetization $p$-wave state into a finite spin-polarized state. The Floquet-engineered bands also acquire a nonzero Chern number whose sign is controlled by the light polarization. For $f$-wave magnets, circularly polarized light induces a net out-of-plane magnetization, offering a direct experimental signature. Our results establish light as an efficient means of controlling magnetic states, with potential applications in spintronics and quantum information.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用椭圆偏振光在p波磁体中实现零净磁化到有限自旋极化态的动态切换，并通过Floquet工程调控能带的陈数；在f波磁体中，圆偏振光可诱导净面外磁化，为光控磁性状态提供新方法。
AI.motivation: 传统磁体存在净磁化，而p波磁体具有零净磁化的奇宇称自旋极化，如何高效操控这类新型磁性状态是一个关键问题。作者旨在探索利用光场实现无磁场、快速、可切换的磁性控制手段。
AI.method: 利用Floquet理论分析，在自旋-轨道耦合的奇宇称磁体中施加椭圆偏振光，通过光场诱导出与动量无关的自旋相关项，实现能带结构的Floquet工程化，从而动态调控自旋极化和拓扑性质。
AI.result: 椭圆偏振光可在p波磁体中产生动量无关的自旋相关项，将零净磁化态切换为有限自旋极化态，且Floquet能带获得非零陈数，符号由光偏振方向控制；在f波磁体中，圆偏振光可诱导净面外磁化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明光是一种高效控制磁性状态的手段，特别适用于零净磁化奇宇称磁体，在自旋电子学和量子信息领域具有潜在应用价值。

title: Macroscopic Polarization and Magnetization from Cavity Vacuum Fluctuations
summary: Cavity light-matter interaction has recently emerged as a new avenue for manipulating material properties without driving fields. Here, we demonstrate that cavity vacuum fluctuations can induce macroscopic polarization (magnetization), even in materials that lack spontaneous polarization (net magnetization) in free space. Starting from the effective photon-free quantum-electrodynamics Hamiltonian, we identify all crystallographic (magnetic) point groups that allow such cavity-induced responses. We derive the form of the corresponding response tensors based on symmetry analysis, whose elements can be obtained by quantum electrodynamical density functional theory (QEDFT) calculations. As representative examples, we show that the cavity-induced polarization in $α$-quartz can be continuously controlled by rotating the cavity. For antiferromagnetic Mn$_3$Sn, we demonstrate that cavity-induced symmetry breaking generates an out-of-plane magnetization, accompanied by an anomalous Hall conductivity component that is forbidden outside the cavity. Our work establishes symmetry as a guiding principle for cavity materials engineering and provides a route for controlling polarization and magnetization through quantum vacuum fluctuations, i.e., cavity materials engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文证明腔真空涨落可以在非自发极化/磁化材料中诱导出宏观极化与磁化，通过对称性分析识别允许此类响应的晶体点群，并以α-石英和Mn₃Sn为例展示了腔材料工程的可行性。
AI.motivation: 探索无需外加驱动场，仅利用腔真空涨落来操控材料极性/磁性属性的新途径，建立对称性作为腔材料工程指导原则的理论基础。
AI.method: 基于有效无光子QED哈密顿量，结合群论对称性分析识别所有允许腔诱导极化/磁化的晶体（磁）点群，推导响应张量形式，并通过QEDFT计算验证。
AI.result: 1）识别出允许腔诱导响应（极化/磁化）的晶体点群；2）α-石英中极化可通过旋转腔连续调控；3）Mn₃Sn中腔诱导出腔外禁阻的面外磁化及反常霍尔电导分量。
AI.conclusion: 对称性可作为腔材料工程的指导原则，真空量子涨落为控制极化与磁化提供了全新途径，拓展了腔光-物质相互作用的材料调控能力。

title: Nonreciprocal phonon propagation via spatially asymmetric magnon-phonon coupling
summary: Nonreciprocal propagation of surface acoustic waves (SAWs) based on the spatial asymmetry of magnon-phonon coupling is demonstrated. This nonreciprocity is enabled by an acoustic wavelength scale thick magnetic layer formed under a thin piezoelectric film. In this configuration, magnon modes activated by dipole-dipole interactions are localized near either the top or bottom interface depending on the propagation direction of the SAW. As a result, the spatial overlap between interfacial magnon and surface phonon modes is expected to become direction dependent, in a manner that leads to distinct unidirectional propagation of SAWs. Notably, the resulting nonreciprocity reaches the highest level among those reported for SAW devices based on a single magnetic layer. This finding will establish a new strategy of nonreciprocal acoustic propagation in a structurally simple magnomechanical device.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在薄压电薄膜下形成声波波长尺度的厚磁性层，利用磁振子-声子耦合的空间不对称性实现了表面声波的非互易传播，并达到了单磁性层SAW器件中最高水平的非互易性。
AI.motivation: 现有SAW非互易器件多依赖复杂结构或多层磁性层，作者希望提出一种结构简单但能实现高效非互易传播的新策略。
AI.method: 在薄压电薄膜下方制备声波波长尺度的厚磁性层，利用偶极-偶极相互作用激发的磁振子模式在SAW不同传播方向下分别局域于顶面或底面界面，从而实现磁振子-声子空间交叠的方向依赖性。
AI.result: 实现了基于单磁性层的SAW非互易传播，且非互易性达到目前同类器件中的最高水平。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为结构简单的磁力机械器件中实现非互易声传播提供了新策略。

title: A Comprehensive Experimental and Theoretical Spectroscopic Study of Proteinogenic Amino Acids
summary: Amino acids are essential building blocks of life, yet our understanding of their chemistry and electronic structure in the solid state remains limited. This is particularly important because amino acids in the solid state are relevant to biological and pharmaceutical processes. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy provides a powerful experimental probe of chemical states and occupied electronic structure; however, most spectroscopy studies of amino acids focus on gas-phase species or surface adsorbates, while crystalline amino acids remain underexplored, largely because of experimental challenges associated with radiation damage. Additionally, the spectra are often complex and difficult to interpret, motivating a combined experimental-theoretical approach. This study combines X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and density functional theory calculations to systematically investigate the core, semi-core, and valence states of 20 proteinogenic amino acids as well as selenomethionine which can be incorporated during protein synthesis and deliver the essential nutrient, Se, required by humans. Calculated relative core binding energies show excellent agreement with experiment and enable reliable assignments. Projections of the density of states provide insight into the influence of local coordination and extended crystal structure, yielding a systematic understanding of the electronic structure and bonding in solid-state AAs. The insights gained from this study enhance the understanding of crystalline amino acids and validate the robustness of an integrated experiment--theory framework.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合X射线光电子能谱和密度泛函理论计算，系统研究了20种蛋白氨基酸及硒代甲硫氨酸在固态下的核、半核及价电子结构，揭示了局域配位和扩展晶体结构对电子结构的影响，验证了实验-理论联合框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: 固态氨基酸在生物和制药过程中至关重要，但对其固态化学和电子结构的理解有限；X射线光电子能谱实验面临辐射损伤等挑战，且谱图复杂难以解析，因此需要实验与理论相结合的系统研究。
AI.method: 结合X射线光电子能谱实验测量与密度泛函理论计算，系统研究了20种蛋白氨基酸及硒代甲硫氨酸的核、半核和价态电子结构，利用相对核结合能计算与实验对比进行归属，并通过态密度投影分析局域配位和晶体结构的影响。
AI.result: 计算的相对核结合能与实验数据高度一致，实现了可靠的光谱归属；态密度投影揭示了局域配位和扩展晶体结构对电子结构的系统影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究增强了对固态氨基酸电子结构和化学键合的理解，验证了集成实验-理论框架的可靠性和鲁棒性。

title: Logarithmic scaling correction in quench dynamics of the J1-J2 Potts model
summary: In conventional quench dynamics governed by the Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM), the defect density generally decays as a pure power law of the quench rate. However, the KZM scaling of the two-dimensional (2D) XY model with topological phase transitions features prominent logarithmic corrections. Nevertheless, it remains unclear whether such logarithmic scaling corrections emerge in discrete-spin systems that host two successive topological phase transitions under thermal quenches. This work investigates the J1-J2 antiferromagnetic Potts model and constructs its equilibrium phase diagram. Based on the temperature ranges of the paramagnetic phase, quasi-long-range ordered (QLRO) phase, long-range ordered phase, and zero-temperature ground state, we design four quench protocols with distinct temperature intervals. Our results demonstrate that quenches terminating in the QLRO phase exhibit logarithmically corrected KZM scaling of the excess energy density, consistent with the dynamical universality class of the 2D XY model. In contrast, quenches ending in the LRO phase, including both finite-temperature and zero-temperature protocols, follow conventional power-law scaling. Our results clearly uncover the characteristic scaling corrections of the J1-J2 Potts model and offer theoretical guidance for future experimental investigations of KZM via photonic simulation platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了J1-J2反铁磁Potts模型在热淬火动力学中的拓扑相变。发现淬火到准长程序（QLRO）相时，过剩能量密度呈现对数修正的KZ标度；而淬火到长程序（LRO）相时则遵循传统幂律标度，揭示了二维XY模型的动力学普适类特征。
AI.motivation: 现有KZM理论在二维XY模型（具有拓扑相变）中显示对数修正，但在离散自旋系统中经历两次连续拓扑相变时，这种对数修正是否仍然存在尚不清楚，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建J1-J2反铁磁Potts模型的平衡相图，根据顺磁相、QLRO相、LRO相及零温基态的温度区间，设计了四种不同温度间隔的淬火协议，通过数值模拟分析过剩能量密度的标度行为。
AI.result: 淬火终止于QLRO相时，过剩能量密度呈现对数修正的KZM标度，与二维XY模型的动力学普适类一致；淬火终止于LRO相（包括有限温度和零温协议）时，遵循传统的纯幂律标度。
AI.conclusion: 清晰揭示了J1-J2 Potts模型的特征标度修正，为未来通过光子模拟平台实验研究KZM提供了理论指导。

title: Twisting-operator approach to identifying gaplessness in SU($N$) fermionic systems
summary: We propose a general necessary condition for a spinful fermion chain with SU(2) spin-rotation symmetry to be gapped. Specifically, we prove that the expectation value of a properly defined fermionic twisting operator asymptotically approaches unity in any gapped phase with finite ground-state degeneracy, with finite-size corrections bounded by $\mathscr{O}(1/L)$. Consequently, a non-unity value in the thermodynamic limit provides a sufficient criterion for identifying gapless fermion chains. We confirm this criterion using the $s$-wave Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) Hamiltonian and determinant quantum Monte Carlo (DQMC) simulations of interacting Hubbard models. We further extend the twisting-operator approach to SU($N$)-symmetric fermionic systems, where the gapped ground-state sector must be SU($N$)-singlet and $\langle \hat{\mathcal{U}}^M\rangle=1+\mathscr{O}(1/L)$ by a fermionic twisting operator $\hat{\mathcal{U}}$ with a suitably chosen integer $M$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个自旋费米子链有能隙的必要条件：通过构造费米子扭曲算符，证明有能隙相中该算符期望值趋于1，反之则系统无能隙，并在BCS模型和Hubbard模型中验证，同时推广到SU(N)对称系统。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以有效区分有能隙和无能隙的费米子链，缺乏一个普适且直接的必要条件来判断系统是否处于有能隙相。
AI.method: 定义了一个特定的费米子扭曲算符，严格证明在有能隙且基态简并有穷的条件下，其期望值在热力学极限下趋近于1，有限尺寸修正为O(1/L)；并利用s-wave BCS哈密顿量和DQMC模拟进行数值验证。
AI.result: 理论证明扭曲算符期望值在有能隙相中渐近为1；数值计算在BCS模型和Hubbard模型中确认该判据有效；将该判据推广到SU(N)对称费米子系统。
AI.conclusion: 该扭曲算符判据为判断费米子链是否具有能隙提供了一种普适且易于计算的方法，填补了该领域的空白。

title: Nitrospinics as a platform from orbital-torque memory to artificial intelligence
summary: The exploration of energy-efficient and functional spintronics has attracted considerable attention. Orbital transport has opened new pathways for current-induced torque generation beyond the conventional spin transport based on the spin Hall effect. In addition, artificial intelligence computing has been demonstrated using spintronic devices. Further progress of these devices can be anticipated through the development of unique and functional materials beyond the existing heavy metals and topological systems with strong spin-orbit coupling. The nitride materials exhibit unique chemical, magnetic, and structural versatility, including antiferromagnetism, high thermal stability, and compatibility with diverse device architectures. Here, we propose Nitrospinics as a conceptual and functional framework that exploits nitride materials for applications ranging from orbital-torque-based spintronic devices to artificial intelligence hardware. Using Cr2N, a two-dimensional nitride MXene with an atomic layered structure, as a prototype system, we discuss how nitrogen contributes to the structural stability, the orbital torque generation, and the interfacial orbital and spin conversion. We further outline key challenges and opportunities toward establishing nitride-based materials for next-generation computing technologies.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“Nitrospinics”（氮自旋电子学）概念框架，利用氮化物材料的独特性能（如反铁磁性、高热稳定性、结构多样性）实现轨道扭矩自旋电子器件和人工智能硬件。以二维氮化物MXene Cr2N为原型系统，展示了氮元素在结构稳定性、轨道扭矩产生及界面轨道-自旋转换中的关键作用，并展望了氮化物材料在未来计算技术中的机遇与挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有自旋电子学依赖于重金属和拓扑材料中强自旋-轨道耦合产生的自旋霍尔效应，但这类材料在能效和功能多样性上存在局限。氮化物具有反铁磁性、高热稳定性、结构可调性和器件兼容性等独特优势，有望突破现有材料体系的瓶颈，实现更高效、更智能的自旋电子器件。
AI.method: 提出Nitrospinics概念框架，以二维氮化物MXene Cr2N作为原型体系，通过其原子层状结构分析氮元素在结构稳定性、轨道扭矩生成以及界面轨道-自旋转换中的具体作用机制。
AI.result: 氮化物材料能够支撑轨道扭矩生成机制，超越了传统自旋霍尔效应的限制；Cr2N原型系统展示了氮元素在实现高效轨道-自旋转换和结构稳定性方面的关键作用；为开发兼具功能和能效优势的下一代计算硬件提供了新的材料平台。
AI.conclusion: Nitrospinics为氮化物材料在轨道扭矩自旋电子学和人工智能硬件领域的应用建立了系统性的理论和实践框架，为突破现有重金属/拓扑材料体系的局限性提供了新方向，有望推动下一代高效、功能化计算技术的发展。

title: Microscopic Conversion of Structural Chirality into Electronic Chirality in Artificial Chiral Clusters
summary:
We investigate how structural chirality is converted into electronic chirality in a two-dimensional cluster model consisting of a triangular-lattice core and three rod-like extensions under a surface-induced polar field.
  By evaluating the electric toroidal monopole (ETM) and the Edelstein effect, we show that both quantities exhibit antisymmetric and nonmonotonic dependence
  on the structural parameter controlling the cluster geometry.
  While the total density of states is almost unaffected by the structural deformation, the ETM-resolved spectrum changes significantly, indicating that chirality is encoded in the symmetry character of the electronic states rather than in the overall electronic spectrum.
  Real-space analysis reveals that the induced ETM is concentrated near the vertices and rods, whereas the Edelstein response extends more broadly into the core region.
  Furthermore, a parameter-decomposition analysis identifies spin-orbit coupling, surface-induced parity mixing, and structural chirality as the essential ingredients for both phenomena.
  Our results clarify the microscopic connection between structural chirality, electronic chirality, and chiral transport responses in artificial surface nanostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过二维三角形晶格核心加三个棒状延伸的团簇模型，研究了结构手性如何转化为电子手性，发现电环形单极子和Edelstein效应随结构参数呈反对称非单调变化，且手性编码在电子态的对称性而非总态密度中。
AI.motivation: 探究在表面极化场下，人工纳米结构中结构手性如何转化为电子手性，以及这种转化如何导致手性输运响应，揭示微观机制。
AI.method: 构建二维三角形晶格核心加三个棒状延伸的团簇模型，在表面诱导极化场下，通过计算电环形单极子(ETM)和Edelstein效应，结合实空间分析和参数分解，研究结构手性到电子手性的转化。
AI.result: ETM和Edelstein效应随结构参数呈反对称非单调变化；总态密度几乎不受影响但ETM分辨谱显著变化；ETM集中在顶点和棒状区域而Edelstein响应扩展到核心区域；自旋轨道耦合、表面诱导宇称混合和结构手性是关键要素。
AI.conclusion: 阐明了人工表面纳米结构中结构手性、电子手性与手性输运响应之间的微观联系，手性编码在电子态的对称性特征中而非整体电子谱中。

title: Derivation of the Boltzmann equation with no "molecular chaos"-type approximation
summary: The paper resolves the problem of the derivation of a completely closed evolution equation for $s$-particle distribution function $F_s(t)$ ($s \le N$) from the Liouville equation for $N \gg 1$-particle distribution function $F_N(t)$ with arbitrary initial condition $F_N(0)$ and without any use of the "molecular chaos" type approximation. The initial correlations are accounted for in this equation in the kernel governing the evolution of $F_s(t)$ via the special projection operator which exactly transforms the inhomogeneous Nakajima-Zwanzig Generalized Master Equation (GME) with an irrelevant initial condition term into the homogenous one. This equation is further simplified by presenting its kernel in the linear in the particles' density $n$ approximation. In this approximation the equations for one-particle $F_1(t)$ and two-particle $F_2(t)$ distribution functions are derived. It is shown that the terms describing the influence of initial correlations in the equation for $F_1(t)$ disappear at the large timescale $t \sim t_{\text{rel}} \gg t_{\text{cor}}$ ($t_{\text{cor}}$ is a short correlation time as compared to a relaxation time $t_{\text{rel}}$ of $F_1(t)$) resulting in the linear Boltzmann equation. This equation can be presented as the nonlinear Boltzmann equation in the time interval $t_{\text{cor}} \ll t \ll t_{\text{rel}}$. At $t_{\text{rel}} \to \infty$ (mean free path $l \to \infty$) the Boltzmann equation holds for all finite times $t \gg t_{\text{cor}}$.

AI.tldr: 本文从刘维尔方程出发，在不使用分子混沌假设的条件下，推导了s粒子分布函数的完全封闭演化方程，并在线性密度近似下得到了单粒子和双粒子分布函数方程，最终导出玻尔兹曼方程。
AI.motivation: 传统推导玻尔兹曼方程需要分子混沌假设，本文旨在严格的统计力学框架下，不依赖该近似，从刘维尔方程直接推导出封闭的s粒子分布函数演化方程，并阐明初始关联的影响及其在长时间尺度下的衰减行为。
AI.method: 利用特殊的投影算子将非齐次的Nakajima-Zwanzig广义主方程转化为齐次形式，从而将初始关联项吸收进核函数中；然后在粒子密度n的线性近似下简化核函数，推导F1和F2的封闭方程。
AI.result: 在t >> t_cor的长时间尺度下，初始关联项衰减消失，F1方程退化为线性玻尔兹曼方程；在t_cor << t << t_rel区间可呈现为非线性玻尔兹曼方程；当t_rel → ∞时，玻尔兹曼方程对所有t >> t_cor成立。
AI.conclusion: 本文严格证明了分子混沌假设并非玻尔兹曼方程推导的必要条件，初始关联的影响在弛豫时间尺度上自然消失，为统计力学的基础提供了更清晰的数学刻画。

title: Multi-Criticality and RG Topology in the Charge-Kondo-Breakdown Scenario in the Cuprates
summary: In this paper, we examine the dynamical charge-Kondo-breakdown scenario proposed for cuprate superconductors within the perspective of renormalization group (RG) topology. By analyzing the coupled RG flow equations governing the effective low-energy theory, we determine the fixed-point structure, stability properties, and global organization of the flow. We find that the putative finite-coupling interacting fixed point is unstable against perturbations transverse to an invariant critical manifold. As a result, generic RG trajectories exhibit runaway behavior. To elucidate the global structure of the theory, we combine analytical solutions of the flow equations with numerical phase portraits and Poincaré compactification. This analysis reveals that the interacting fixed point exhibits a marginally relevant instability, generating an exponentially large but finite crossover scale. The resulting flow topology closely resembles anisotropy-driven runaway flows encountered in fluctuation-induced weakly first-order transitions. Within this framework, the apparent quantum-critical regime can be understood as an extended crossover controlled by a near-critical fixed point, rather than by asymptotic scale invariance. The results obtained indicate that the existence of extended scaling behavior does not, by itself, imply the presence of a stable interacting quantum critical state. More generally, our analysis demonstrates how RG topology can provide a powerful diagnostic for distinguishing genuine criticality from pseudo-critical behavior in theories of strongly correlated quantum matter.

AI.tldr: 本文利用重整化群拓扑分析研究了铜氧化物超导体的电荷-Kondo击穿场景，发现相互作用不动点存在边缘相关不稳定性，导致有限交叉尺度，揭示了表观量子临界行为实际上是赝临界现象。
AI.motivation: 理解铜氧化物超导体中电荷-Kondo击穿场景的临界行为本质，区分真正的量子临界性与赝临界行为。
AI.method: 耦合RG流方程分析、不动点结构分析、稳定性分析、Poincaré紧化、数值相图与解析解结合。
AI.result: 相互作用不动点存在横向不稳定性；RG轨迹呈现跑离行为；边缘相关不稳定性产生指数级大但有限的交叉尺度；流拓扑类似于各向异性驱动的弱一级相变。
AI.conclusion: 扩展标度行为的存在并不必然意味着存在稳定的相互作用量子临界态；RG拓扑是区分真正临界性与赝临界行为的有效诊断工具。

title: Raman spectroscopy of van der Waals topological magnet GdGaI
summary: We report polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy of a van der Waals compound GdGaI that is a candidate for excitonic insulators. By combining the symmetry analysis with density functional theory calculations, we identify six Raman-active phonons. The spectra exhibit only the expected anharmonic hardening down to 4 K: no additional peaks, no soft modes, and no signatures of zone folding are observed. This result indicates that any lattice distortion is below our experimental sensitivity, supporting an electronically driven origin for the band reconstruction reported by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy rather than an electron-phonon-driven mechanism. Moreover, we observe a pronounced circular dichroism of the $A_{1g}$ modes under an out-of-plane magnetic field. Based on symmetry considerations, we attribute this dichroic response to chiral $A_{1g}$ phonons with opposite angular momenta generated by spin-phonon coupling in the time-reversal-broken state. The temperature evolution of the degree of circular polarization further suggests that circularly polarized Raman spectroscopy detects the emergence of short-range antiferromagnetic correlations. Our results highlight GdGaI as a promising platform in which excitonic order, magnetism, and circularly polarized phonons can be intertwined, and demonstrate that circular-polarization Raman provides a sensitive probe of spin-phonon coupling in excitonic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用偏振分辨拉曼光谱研究激子绝缘体候选材料GdGaI，识别出六个拉曼活性声子模式，未观察到晶格畸变信号，支持电子驱动而非电子-声子驱动的能带重构机制。同时发现面外磁场下A1g模式的圆二色性，归因于自旋-声子耦合产生的手性声子，圆偏振拉曼光谱可探测短程反铁磁关联的涌现。
AI.motivation: 探究GdGaI中激子绝缘体相变的驱动力机制（电子驱动 vs 电子-声子驱动），以及激子序、磁性与声子之间的耦合关系。
AI.method: 实验上采用偏振分辨拉曼光谱（含圆偏振分析）结合对称性分析与DFT计算；在4 K至室温变温测量，施加面外磁场观测圆二色性。
AI.result: 1) 识别出6个拉曼活性声子；2) 仅观察到预期非简谐硬化，无额外峰、软模或能带折叠信号，排除显著晶格畸变；3) 发现A1g模式在磁场下呈现圆二色性；4) 圆偏振度随温度演化反映短程反铁磁关联的出现。
AI.conclusion: GdGaI的能带重构由电子驱动机制主导；圆偏振拉曼光谱可灵敏探测激子系统中自旋-声子耦合及磁关联；GdGaI是研究激子序、磁性和手性声子交织的理想平台。

title: THz-Driven Floquet Spin Valve-Modulator
comment: 69 pages, 5 figures. Contains extensive analytical derivations within the text and detailed Appendices on the gauge-invariant high-frequency approximation and non-Hermitian determinant factorization
summary: Within the scattering matrix ($S$-matrix) framework adapted to the high-frequency Floquet--Magnus formalism based on the length gauge, we investigate spin-dependent quantum transport in a 1D quantum ring with an asymmetric ($π/2$) configuration of quantum point contacts. We demonstrate the realization of a contactless electromagnetic analog of the Datta--Das spin field-effect transistor with ferromagnetic leads operating at zero static magnetic field. It is shown that an off-resonance terahertz (THz) field enables high-precision switching between spin channels without altering the static parameters of the nanostructure. Driven by an electronic Vernier effect, the quantum interference in the asymmetric geometry yields a selective spin phase rotator alongside an ultra-high-contrast current-suppression regime (``optical shutter''). The proposed architecture is fundamentally robust against multiphoton leakage sidebands, offering a thermally immune, high-speed alternative to conventional semiconductor static spin transistors.

AI.tldr: 本文在散射矩阵框架下，结合基于长度规范的高频Floquet-Magnus理论，研究了具有非对称（π/2）量子点接触构型的1D量子环中的自旋相关量子输运。展示了在零静磁场下，基于无接触电磁模拟的Datta-Das自旋场效应晶体管。太赫兹场可实现无需改变静态参数的高精度自旋通道切换，并借助电子游标效应实现选择性自旋相位旋转器和超高对比度电流抑制（“光学快门”）。该架构对多光子泄漏边带具有鲁棒性，是传统半导体静态自旋晶体管的热免疫、高速替代方案。
AI.motivation: 传统Datta-Das自旋场效应晶体管依赖静态磁场或铁磁接触，存在热稳定性差、速度受限等问题。本文旨在利用太赫兹光场驱动，在零静磁场下实现纯电学自旋调控，克服传统方案的局限性。
AI.method: 采用散射矩阵（S-matrix）与高频Floquet-Magnus形式（长度规范）相结合的理论框架，构建了具有非对称（π/2）量子点接触的1D量子环结构，并利用电子游标效应实现自旋相位的选择性操控。
AI.result: 实现了零静磁场下太赫兹场驱动的自旋通道高精度开关；获得了超高对比度的电流抑制（光学快门效应）；系统对多光子泄漏边带具有显著鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种热免疫、高速的新型自旋晶体管架构，可作为传统半导体静态自旋晶体管的有力替代方案，在量子计算和自旋电子学中具有应用潜力。

title: Random walks in Dirichlet random environment in dimension $d+1$
comment: 27 pages, 13 figures. Data gnuplot files for plots available at https://dare.uol.de/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=doi:10.57782/G0HPXH
summary: The atypical behaviour of random walks in time-dependent random environment was recently related to Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) growth. While this is now well-understood in spatial dimension $d=1$, further efforts are necessary to better understand these connections in dimensions $d>1$. In this paper, we study this problem numerically for $d=1, 2$ and $3$, focusing on a discrete model with Dirichlet distributed transition probabilities. This model is a generalization of an integrable model in $d=1$, and it has the advantage of admitting an explicit, product-form, stationary measure. We verify that the growth of the variance of the logarithm of point-to-point probabilities, namely from the origin to position $x$ in time $t$, is compatible with KPZ growth in dimension $d=1$ and $d=2$. In spatial dimension $d=3$, we confirm the existence of a phase transition as the angle $\vert x\vert /t$ increases and we obtain a lower bound based on an exact second moment calculation. We find that in the weak disorder phase the point-to-point probability acquires a heavy tailed distribution, and that in the strong disorder phase the cumulants of its logarithm grow with time. Further, we show that for this model, we can compute exactly the sample to sample variance of the thermal average $\overline{ \langle x \rangle^2}$ and that it is related to the extreme diffusion coefficient introduced recently.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值模拟研究了d=1,2,3维下Dirichlet分布随机游走模型与KPZ增长的关联，验证了d=1,2维中方差增长符合KPZ标度，揭示了d=3维中存在相变现象，并精确计算了热平均方差与极端扩散系数的关系。
AI.motivation: 虽然一维时变环境下随机游走的非典型行为与KPZ增长的关系已较清楚，但高维(d>1)情况下这种关联仍需进一步研究。本文旨在通过数值方法探索高维情形下的KPZ关联。
AI.method: 采用Dirichlet分布转移概率的离散模型进行数值模拟，该模型是一维可积模型的推广，具有显式的乘积形式平稳测度。研究d=1,2,3维下点对点概率对数的方差增长，并在d=3维中通过精确二阶矩计算得到下界。
AI.result: (1) d=1和d=2维中，点对点概率对数的方差增长与KPZ标度兼容；(2) d=3维中，随角度|x|/t增大存在相变：弱无序阶段分布呈重尾，强无序阶段累积量随时间增长；(3) 精确计算了热平均的样本间方差，并关联到极端扩散系数。
AI.conclusion: 本文扩展了随机游走与KPZ增长的联系到高维情形，为理解d>1维时变环境随机游走的相变行为提供了数值证据和理论下界。

title: Spatially Dispersive Second-Harmonic Generation in Ferroaxial Systems
summary: Spatially dispersive second-harmonic generation (SHG) provides a powerful probe of centrosymmetric multipolar states beyond the electric-dipole approximation. We develop a gauge-consistent microscopic theory of spatially dispersive SHG that treats electric-quadrupole (EQ) and magnetic-dipole (MD) processes on equal footing. Applying the formulation to a minimal triangular cluster model with ferroaxial order, which is closely related to an electric toroidal dipole, we show that the nonlinear optical response directly reflects the ferroaxial order parameter. The agreement between length- and velocity-gauge calculations confirms the gauge consistency of the formulation. We further demonstrate that the EQ and MD contributions exhibit different spectral weights despite sharing the same resonance energies. In particular, the MD channel can dominate over the EQ channel at selected resonances, indicating that it is not merely a perturbative correction. Our results establish that both EQ and MD processes are essential for a quantitative description of spatially dispersive SHG in ferroaxial materials and provide a microscopic basis for interpreting nonlinear optical signatures of centrosymmetric multipolar order.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一种规范一致的空间色散二次谐波产生(SHG)微观理论，将电四极(EQ)和磁偶极(MD)过程平等处理。通过对具有铁轴序的三角团簇模型分析，发现非线性光学响应直接反映铁轴序参量，且EQ和MD贡献具有不同光谱权重，表明两者对定量描述空间色散SHG不可或缺。
AI.motivation: 现有空间色散SHG理论在处理中心对称多极态时，对电四极(EQ)和磁偶极(MD)过程的处理不够一致，且缺少对铁轴序等新型有序态非线性光学响应的微观理解。
