AI.method: 发展规范一致的微观理论，在长度规范和速度规范下平等处理EQ和MD过程；应用于具有铁轴序的最小三角团簇模型（与电环形偶极子密切相关），进行数值计算。
AI.result: 1) 长度规范和速度规范计算结果一致，验证了理论的规范一致性；2) EQ和MD贡献虽共享相同共振能量但具有不同光谱权重；3) 在特定共振处，MD通道可主导EQ通道，并非仅仅是微扰修正。
AI.conclusion: EQ和MD过程对定量描述铁轴材料中空间色散SHG均不可或缺，该工作为解释中心对称多极序的非线性光学信号提供了微观基础。

title: Synergistic Interface Stability and High Room-Temperature Ionic Conductivity for Wide-Temperature All-Solid-State Batteries Based on Li6+xSixSb1-xS5I Electrolytes
summary: Solid-state lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) are increasingly recognized for their exceptional energy density and safety. However, their widespread adoption is challenged by persistent issues such as thermal and electrochemical instability, dendrite formation, and limited compatibility with high-voltage cathodes. Sulfide-based solid electrolytes (SEs), particularly iodide argyrodites, offer outstanding ionic conductivity and stability; however, their practical application is constrained by the formation of space-charge layers, slow ion transport, and susceptibility to dendrite penetration. To address these challenges, we synthesized a novel Li6.6Si0.6Sb0.4S5I argyrodite electrolyte via ball milling and heat treatment, achieving a remarkable room-temperature ionic conductivity of 9.9 mS cm^-1. The electrolyte was integrated with a LiNbO3-coated LiNi0.7Co0.1Mn0.2O2 cathode to form an all-solid-state battery, which demonstrated an initial discharge capacity of 171.2 mAh g^-1, retained 84.2% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5C, and maintained stable cycling across a broad temperature range from -20 degrees C to 60 degrees C. Our study shows that tailored electrolyte composition and a composite cathode configuration significantly enhance cycling stability and improve interfacial protection. These findings highlight the potential of Si-doped antimony-type iodide argyrodites for next-generation high-performance all-solid-state batteries, offering durable operation under diverse thermal conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过球磨和热处理合成了新型Li6.6Si0.6Sb0.4S5I硫银锗矿电解质，室温离子电导率达9.9 mS cm^-1，与LiNbO3包覆的NCM712正极组装的全固态电池在0.5C下循环200次后容量保持率达84.2%，并在-20°C至60°C宽温域内稳定工作。
AI.motivation: 传统固态锂电池面临热/电化学不稳定性、枝晶生长及与高压正极兼容性差等问题。硫化物固态电解质虽具有优异离子电导率，但受限于空间电荷层、慢离子传输和枝晶穿透。因此需要开发新型电解质材料以兼顾高离子电导率、界面稳定性和宽温域工作能力。
AI.method: 采用球磨和热处理方法合成Li6.6Si0.6Sb0.4S5I硫银锗矿电解质，并使用LiNbO3包覆LiNi0.7Co0.1Mn0.2O2正极构建复合正极结构，组装全固态电池进行电化学性能测试。
AI.result: 电解质室温离子电导率达9.9 mS cm^-1；全固态电池初始放电容量171.2 mAh g^-1，0.5C下200次循环后容量保持率84.2%；在-20°C至60°C宽温域内保持稳定循环。
AI.conclusion: 定制的电解质组分与复合正极配置可显著增强循环稳定性和界面保护，Si掺杂锑型碘硫银锗矿是下一代高性能全固态电池的有力候选材料。

title: Spin-wave softening across the uniform-to-stripe domain transition in iron garnet film
comment: Main text: 8 pages, 6 figures. Supplementary Material: 4 pages, 4 figures
summary: Spin-wave spectra across transitions between uniform and textured phases can offer deep insight into both symmetry-breaking physics and self-assembled magnonic bands. However, experiments require a material platform that combines low damping, well-defined textures, and spectroscopic access. Here, we study a Bi-doped iron-garnet film with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA), which undergoes a uniform-to-stripe-domain transition as a function of in-plane magnetic field. Real-space imaging by magnetic force microscopy reveals field-reorientable stripe domains aligned with the in-plane field, while reciprocal-space measurements using thermal microfocused Brillouin light scattering ($μ$-BLS) reveal the softening of a low-frequency spin-wave branch near the transition and the appearance of additional modes in the stripe-domain state. Calculated dispersion relations identify finite-$k$ softening in the Damon-Eshbach geometry ($k \perp M$), with the corresponding wavelength matching the stripe periodicity at the transition. In addition, a $μ$-BLS spectral model reproduces the measured mode frequencies and relative intensities at selected fixed fields. Micromagnetic simulations capture the field-driven formation of the stripe state and reproduce the experimental thermal $μ$-BLS spectra. Our findings establish BiYIG with PMA as a model low-damping platform for studying spin-wave freezing, stripe-domain modes, and reconfigurable magnonic band structures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有垂直磁各向异性的Bi掺杂铁石榴石薄膜，通过显微聚焦布里渊光散射和磁力显微镜，揭示了从均匀相到条纹畴相转变过程中的自旋波软化、新模式出现及色散关系，确立了BiYIG作为研究自旋波冻结和可重构磁子能带的低阻尼模型平台。
AI.motivation: 理解均匀相与织构相之间转变时的自旋波谱，有助于揭示对称性破缺物理和自组装磁子能带，但目前缺乏兼具低阻尼、明确织构和光谱可及性的材料平台。
AI.method: 使用磁力显微镜进行实空间成像，采用热显微聚焦布里渊光散射（μ-BLS）进行倒易空间测量，并结合理论色散关系计算、μ-BLS光谱模型和微磁学模拟。
AI.result: 发现了相变附近低频自旋波支的软化，条纹畴态中出现额外模式；识别了Damon-Eshbach几何中的有限波矢软化，软化波长与条纹周期匹配；光谱模型和微磁模拟均复现了实验观测。
AI.conclusion: BiYIG薄膜是一种研究自旋波冻结、条纹畴模式和可重构磁子能带结构的理想低阻尼模型平台。

title: Kinetically-Arrested Phase Separation leads to Tunable Domain Structures in Vapor-Deposited Glasses
summary: The characteristic length scale of phase-separated organic thin film blends is a critical structural parameter governing the performance and functionality of organic electronic devices. The arrested morphologies of vapor-deposited organic thin films result from the interplay between thermodynamic driving forces and kinetic constraints during deposition. Here, we aim to isolate the role of kinetic effects in phase separation by varying the deposition rate at a constant substrate temperature for a co-deposited molecular glass blend of N,N'-bis(3-methylphenyl)-N,N'-diphenylbenzidine (TPD) and Disperse Orange 37 (DO37). The dependence of morphology on deposition rate is quantified using power spectral density (PSD) analysis of atomic force microscopy (AFM) images. Two distinct deposition rate-dependent length scales at the surface reveal how deposition kinetics directly influence domain size and film topography. Complementary Resonant Soft X-ray Scattering (RSoXS) measurements indicate that phase separation extends throughout the film thickness. These observations are consistent with the surface equilibration mechanism previously described for homogeneous vapor-deposited films, in which enhanced surface mobility allows molecules in the growing film to partially equilibrate into distinct surface-templated states during deposition. In the current work, this mechanism allows the multi-component blend to phase separate and coarsen into a structure with multiple length scales before kinetically arresting to an extent that depends on the deposition rate. The demonstration of finely tunable domain size with deposition rate provides strategies to design new organic electronic devices with desired morphologies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了气相共沉积有机小分子共混薄膜（TPD与DO37）中，沉积速率对相分离形貌特征长度尺度的影响。通过AFM的PSD分析和RSoXS表征，发现沉积速率调控表面迁移介导的平衡过程，从而产生可精细调控的多尺度相分离结构。
AI.motivation: 有机电子器件的性能依赖于薄膜中相分离的特征长度尺度。当前研究旨在从热力学与动力学耦合中分离出沉积速率这一纯动力学因素，探究其对相分离形貌的独立影响。
AI.method: 在恒定基底温度下改变共沉积速率，制备TPD:DO37分子玻璃共混薄膜。利用AFM图像进行功率谱密度（PSD）分析定量表征表面形貌，结合共振软X射线散射（RSoXS）探测体相相分离结构。
AI.result: 发现两种依赖于沉积速率的特征长度尺度；RSoXS证实相分离贯穿整个膜厚；沉积速率越快，表面迁移平衡受限，域尺寸越小；反之则越粗化。
AI.conclusion: 沉积速率可作为一种精细调控有机共混薄膜相分离域尺寸的有效手段，为设计具有特定形貌的有机电子器件提供了新的策略。

title: Optimal Finite-Time Control of Nonreciprocal Brownian Dimers: Thermodynamic Anomaly and Multiple Transitions
summary: We solve exactly a finite-time thermodynamic optimal control problem for two nonreciprocally interacting Brownian particles translated by two harmonic traps. The controller manipulates both the center and separation of the pair. Nonreciprocal interactions generate an internal active force that couples these two channels. The optimal protocol is oscillatory, deliberately opens the dimer even when the target separation is unchanged, and can extract work during transport. A central finding is a finite critical time beyond which the external-work infimum is $-\infty$: at any prescribed duration beyond this threshold, both extractable work and output power are unbounded. Physical regularizations such as finite trap range and force saturation restore a finite optimum and convert the anomaly into optimal-protocol transitions: in the zero-target case, a hard finite range produces a first-order-like jump from the zero protocol to a maximum-range protocol, whereas smooth force saturation gives a continuous, second-order-like onset. Under finite-range constraints, the optimal protocol can further undergo multiple finite-time transitions, producing multiple work-duration kinks with no qualitative analog in prior studies.

AI.tldr: 本文精确求解了非互易相互作用的布朗粒子在有限时间热力学最优控制问题。发现了临界时间，超过该时间外部功下界为负无穷，并通过物理正则化（有限阱程、力饱和）恢复了有限最优值，导致了最优协议的一阶或二阶相变。
AI.motivation: 研究非互易相互作用下布朗粒子的有限时间热力学最优控制问题，探索非互易性对最优协议和可提取功的影响。
AI.method: 精确求解了由两个谐振阱平移的两个非互易相互作用布朗粒子的有限时间热力学最优控制问题。控制器操纵粒子对的中心和分离距离。通过物理正则化（有限阱程和力饱和）处理奇异性。
AI.result: 发现了有限临界时间，超过该时间外部功下界为负无穷；物理正则化恢复有限最优值；零目标情况出现一阶或二阶最优协议转变；有限阱程约束下出现多个有限时间转变。
AI.conclusion: 非互易相互作用导致异常的热力学行为，物理正则化将奇异行为转化为最优协议的相变，为理解非平衡系统中主动力的作用提供了新的视角。

title: How to measure loop currents in scanning tunneling microscopy
summary: The emergence of loop current phases, where spontaneous loops of orbital currents give rise to a weak local magnetic moments, has been proposed to exist in a number of quantum materials based on measurements that pick up weak signatures of time reversal symmetry breaking or small magnetic moment order. The most prominent example is as an explanation of the pseudogap phase on the underdoped side of the phase diagram of the high-temperature cuprate superconductors, but more recently, it has been proposed to occur in Kagome materials and at the surface layer of Sr$_2$RuO$_4$. Experimental results have, however, been inconclusive so far, some detecting signatures that can be understood as emerging due to loop current phases, whilst others have not detected any significant proof. One of the techniques that should be able to pick up local signatures of loop current orders is low temperature scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM/STS), however firm predictions of how to detect them are missing. Here, we provide specific predictions for how loop current orders in a square lattice can be seen in spectroscopic maps, using models of the cuprate high-temperature superconductors and of the surface layer of Sr$_2$RuO$_4$. We find that, besides lifting degeneracies at the specific ordering vector of the loop current order, a finite spin polarisation emerges when spin-orbit coupling is present, signatures of which can be detected in spin-polarised STM.

AI.tldr: 本文针对量子材料中环形电流相（loop current phases）的探测难题，利用铜氧化物高温超导体和Sr₂RuO₄表面层的模型，通过理论计算预测了这种轨道电流序在扫描隧道显微镜/谱学（STM/STS）中的可观测特征，特别是发现当存在自旋-轨道耦合时会出现有限的自旋极化信号，可通过自旋极化STM检测。
AI.motivation: 环形电流相被认为是解释铜氧化物超导体赝能隙相、Kagome材料及Sr₂RuO₄表面层异常现象的关键机制，但现有实验证据相互矛盾，且缺乏如何利用STM/STS直接探测这种局域轨道序的明确理论预测。
AI.method: 基于铜氧化物高温超导体和Sr₂RuO₄表面层的晶格模型，理论计算环形电流序在STS谱图中的特征信号，并分析自旋-轨道耦合效应下自旋极化STM的可观测信号。
AI.result: 研究发现环形电流序不仅会在特定序矢量处解除能带简并，还会在自旋-轨道耦合存在时产生有限的自旋极化，这些特征可通过自旋极化STM检测到。
AI.conclusion: 提供了利用STM/STS探测方形晶格中环形电流序的具体可验证预测，为后续实验鉴别环形电流相的存在提供了理论指导。

title: Analytical Retrieval of Material Parameters in Monolayer Transition-Metal Dichalcogenides Based on a Solvable Exciton Model
summary: We develop an analytical procedure to retrieve fundamental material parameters of monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides from optical and magneto-optical exciton spectra, based on the solvable modified Kratzer model. The proposed retrieval procedure naturally consists of two complementary stages. In the first stage, explicit inversion formulas determine the quasiparticle bandgap, effective screening parameter, and energy scaling factor directly from the experimentally measured energies of the three lowest excitonic states, from which the screening length is subsequently obtained. In the second stage, an analytical expression for the magnetic-field dependence of the exciton energies independently yields the reduced exciton mass, from which the surrounding dielectric constant is then calculated. Once the complete set of material parameters has been retrieved, the framework analytically predicts the diamagnetic coefficients, exciton radii, and complete magnetoexciton spectra without introducing additional fitting parameters or matrix diagonalization. The method is applied to a broad range of experimental samples for WSe$_2$, WS$_2$, MoS$_2$, MoSe$_2$, and MoTe$_2$ monolayers embedded in different dielectric environments. The retrieved material parameters are in good agreement with independent experimental measurements and previous Rytova--Keldysh (RK) calculations, while the predicted excitonic properties accurately reproduce available magneto-optical observations. The proposed analytical theory provides an efficient, physically transparent alternative to conventional numerical fitting procedures and offers an effective tool for the rapid characterization of two-dimensional semiconductors via excitonic spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 本文基于可解修正Kratzer模型，开发了一种从光学和磁-光学激子光谱中反演单层过渡金属二硫属化物（TMDs）基本材料参数的分析方法。该方法分两个互补阶段：第一阶段通过显式反演公式从实验测量的三个最低激子态能量直接确定准粒子带隙、有效屏蔽参数和能量缩放因子；第二阶段利用激子能量磁场依赖性的解析表达式独立获得约化激子质量。该方法成功应用于WSe₂、WS₂、MoS₂、MoSe₂和MoTe₂等单层材料，反演参数与实验测量和Rytova-Keldysh计算结果吻合良好。
AI.motivation: 传统数值拟合程序在提取TMDs材料参数时效率低、物理透明度不足，且依赖于矩阵对角化等复杂计算。作者旨在开发一种解析的、高效的替代方法，能够直接从激子光谱数据中快速、准确地反演关键材料参数。
AI.method: 基于可解修正Kratzer模型，建立两阶段分析程序：阶段1利用显式反演公式从三个最低激子态能量提取准粒子带隙、有效屏蔽参数和能量缩放因子；阶段2通过激子能量随磁场变化的解析表达式独立获取约化激子质量，进而计算介电常数，最终无需额外拟合参数即可预测抗磁系数、激子半径和完整磁激子谱。
AI.result: 该方法对WSe₂, WS₂, MoS₂, MoSe₂, MoTe₂等多种单层TMD材料在不同介电环境下的实验样品进行了验证，反演得到的材料参数与独立实验测量和Rytova-Keldysh计算结果高度一致，预测的激子性质准确再现了已有的磁-光学观测数据。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的解析理论为二维半导体的激子光谱表征提供了一种高效、物理透明的工具，可作为传统数值拟合方法的有效替代，显著简化材料参数的提取流程，并无需引入额外拟合参数或矩阵对角化。

title: Exact theory of chirality-dependent p-wave magnetism and Edelstein effect in spin spirals
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. This work was supported by the EIC Pathfinder OPEN grant 101129641 "Orbital Engineering for Innovative Electronics" and by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG): Project No. 328545488 - CRC/TRR 227, Project No. B12 and by the German Excellence Strategy -EXC3112/1 -533767171 (Center for Chiral Electronics)
summary: Spin-momentum locking is widely regarded as a hallmark of relativistic spin-orbit coupling. Here we demonstrate analytically that it can instead emerge solely from magnetic chirality. Solving the minimal tight-binding model of electrons coupled to a spin spiral using a generalized Bloch theorem, we show that the spiral generates chirality-dependent p-wave magnetism characterized by the antisymmetric spin texture $\boldsymbol{s}(\boldsymbol{k})=-\boldsymbol{s}(-\boldsymbol{k})$. The exact solution further yields closed-form expressions for the electrical conductivity and the spin Edelstein susceptibility, revealing a microscopic mechanism by which magnetic chirality alone can generate spin polarization without spin-orbit coupling, with direct implications also for chirality-induced spin selectivity. In the strong exchange-coupling regime, the spin-dependent physics of the spin spiral becomes directly analogous to the orbital-dependent physics of electrons propagating through a non-magnetic helix. Our work establishes a minimal exactly solvable model of chirality-induced spin-momentum locking and spin-charge conversion beyond the conventional spin-orbit coupled paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文通过紧束缚模型解析证明了磁性手性可以独立于自旋-轨道耦合产生自旋-动量锁定效应，并给出了电导率和自旋Edelstein磁化率的闭式解，为手性诱导的自旋选择性提供了微观机制。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为自旋-动量锁定是相对论性自旋-轨道耦合的标志性特征。作者希望证明磁性手性本身（无需自旋-轨道耦合）也能产生这一效应，打破现有范式。
AI.method: 构建了电子与自旋螺旋耦合的最小紧束缚模型，利用广义Bloch定理求解，解析推导了手性依赖的p波磁性、自旋纹理、电导率和自旋Edelstein磁化率。
AI.result: (1) 自旋螺旋产生手性依赖的p波磁性，自旋纹理满足s(k)=-s(-k)；(2) 导出了电导率和自旋Edelstein磁化率的闭式解；(3) 强交换耦合下自旋螺旋的物理与无磁螺旋线中电子传播的轨道物理直接类比。
AI.conclusion: 建立了超越传统自旋-轨道耦合范式的手性诱导自旋-动量锁定和自旋-电荷转换的最小精确可解模型，为手性诱导自旋选择性效应提供了新视角。

title: Stable valleys in the glassy landscape of a low-density parity-check (LDPC) code
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures + 22 pages, 7 figures. Comments welcome
summary: Classical low-density parity-check (cLDPC) codes defined on expander graphs are a fundamental ingredient in the construction of good quantum LDPC codes, a recent milestone in quantum error correction. They also define interesting statistical mechanics models in their own right, as they include examples of spin glass order without quenched randomness or frustration. We investigate this via a case study of a cLDPC code on a locally tree-like expander graph. Recursive techniques on trees, made possible by the locally tree-like property, probe a menagerie of stable, incongruent valleys induced by imposing different boundary conditions at low temperature. A complementary numerical study of the valleys on closed finite graphs reveals the inequivalence of the microcanonical and canonical ensemble for certain valleys.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究局部树状扩展图上的经典LDPC码，发现其在低温下存在多种稳定且不一致的能量谷，揭示了自旋玻璃序的存在，并且某些谷中微正则系综与正则系综不等价。
AI.motivation: 经典LDPC码是构建量子LDPC码的基础，同时它们本身定义了有趣的统计力学模型，包含无淬火随机性或阻挫的自旋玻璃序。作者希望深入理解这一现象。
AI.method: 以局部树状扩展图上的cLDPC码为案例，利用局部树状性质在树上进行递归分析，研究不同边界条件下低温时的能量谷结构；同时在有限闭图上进行数值研究，比较微正则与正则系综。
AI.result: 发现了多种稳定且不一致的能量谷；某些谷中微正则系综与正则系综不等价。
AI.conclusion: cLDPC码在局部树状扩展图上展现出丰富的自旋玻璃行为，且系综不等价性暗示了非平衡统计力学特性，对量子纠错码的设计有理论意义。

title: Coherence-driven origin of metamagnetism in anisotropic heavy-fermion systems
summary: A number of heavy-fermion materials exhibit magnetic field-induced metamagnetism: on applying a field along the magnetic hard axis, the magnetization first rises gradually, then jumps abruptly once a critical field is reached. Despite decades of phenomenological modeling, the microscopic origin of the pronounced magnetic anisotropy underlying this behavior has remained unresolved. The same is true of a related, long-standing puzzle: an anomalous maximum in the hard-axis susceptibility versus temperature. Both are complicated in $5f$ compounds by the dual localized-itinerant character of the relevant electrons. Here we develop an analytic $c$--$f$ theory of magnetic anisotropy in heavy-fermion metamagnets, identifying the mixed susceptibility $χ_{\rm cf}(T,h,p)$ as a single thermodynamic observable that unifies the anisotropic response across temperature, field, and pressure. We test this theory against primary and literature data for the heavy-fermion superconductor UTe$_2$, finding excellent quantitative agreement in the temperature, field, and pressure evolution of its magnetic anisotropy -- including a Kondo-coherence origin for the anomalous hard-axis susceptibility maximum, which we show is directly connected to the metamagnetic transition itself. Our results establish a general, microscopic, coherence-driven framework for anisotropic metamagnetism, applicable across the broad class of heavy-fermion compounds that display this phenomenology.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一套c-f解析理论，揭示了重费米子超导体UTe₂中磁场诱导的变磁性与磁各向异性的微观起源，指出混合磁化率χ_cf是统一描述温度、磁场和压力下各向异性响应的关键热力学观测量，并证明反常硬轴磁化率极大值来源于近藤相干性，与变磁相变直接关联。
AI.motivation: 重费米子材料中磁场沿磁硬轴诱导的变磁性（metamagnetism）现象及其伴随的磁各向异性的微观起源长期未解，尤其是在5f电子体系中局域与巡游双重特性的复杂背景下。此外，硬轴磁化率随温度变化出现反常极大值的谜题同样悬而未决。
AI.method: 作者发展了一个解析的c-f理论（c-f theory），引入混合磁化率χ_cf(T,h,p)作为统一的热力学观测量，将温度、磁场和压力下的各向异性响应联系起来，并在重费米子超导体UTe₂上对理论进行了实验验证。
AI.result: 理论在温度、磁场和压力的演化上与UTe₂的磁各向异性数据取得了极好的定量吻合。成功解释了硬轴磁化率反常极大值起源于近藤相干性（Kondo coherence），并证明该极大值与变磁相变直接相关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个基于近藤相干性的普适微观框架，适用于所有呈现各向异性变磁现象的重费米子材料，为理解这类系统中长期存在的磁各向异性与变磁性的谜题提供了统一的理论基础。

title: A Thermodynamic Pinning Criterion for Two-Dimensional Structural Superlubricity
summary: Incommensurability and elastic reconstruction do not by themselves define a structurally superlubric phase. We define fully sliding and pinned zero-temperature phases by $\limsup_{A\to\infty}τ_{\rm dep}^{\max}(A)=0$ and $\liminf_{A\to\infty}τ_{\rm dep}^{\min}(A)>0$, respectively; $Λ_n=|V_n|G_{n,i}[D_{\rm rel}^{-1}(\mathbf q_n)]_{ij}G_{n,j}$ measures only reconstruction susceptibility. Translational covariance then proves that a clean, smooth, infinite moiré continuum can reconstruct without acquiring a bulk sliding barrier. We restore atomic sampling in a two-dimensional discrete model of graphene/hBN and test both a diffusion quantum Monte Carlo first-star potential and a 15-harmonic Leven potential across three rational approximants and five directions. No physical-coupling equilibrium or metastable barrier is resolved. The Leven spectrum raises the largest tested $Λ$ from $0.142$ to $0.212$, while artificial scaling through $Λ=1$ reaches uncontrolled strain before a size-independent threshold appears. The tested zero-temperature in-plane models are therefore consistent with an elastically relaxed sliding regime; $Λ=1$ is a reconstruction scale, not a static phase criterion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了结构超润滑的严格定义，证明莫尔连续体可以通过重构而不产生滑动势垒，并通过石墨烯/hBN的离散模型测试表明，零温面内模型与弹性松弛滑移状态一致，Λ=1是重构尺度而非静态相判据。
AI.motivation: 现有研究认为不可公度性和弹性重构本身即可定义结构超润滑相，但缺乏严格的零温相变判据，需要明确区分完全滑动相和钉扎相的定义，并检验重构与滑动势垒之间的关系。
AI.method: 定义了零温下完全滑动相和钉扎相的严格判据，引入Λ_n作为重构敏感性度量；利用平移协变性证明莫尔连续体可重构而不产生势垒；在石墨烯/hBN二维离散模型中，采用扩散量子蒙特卡洛势和15谐波Leven势，在三种有理近似和五个方向上测试平衡态和亚稳态势垒。
AI.result: 未发现物理耦合平衡态或亚稳态势垒；Leven谱将最大Λ从0.142提升至0.212；人工将Λ缩放至1会导致达到不可控应变，且仍无尺寸无关阈值出现。
AI.conclusion: 所测试的零温面内模型与弹性松弛滑移状态一致；Λ=1是重构尺度而非静态相判据，推翻了将Λ=1作为超润滑-钉扎相变阈值的既有观点。

title: Frequency-Division Multiplexing in Magnonic Waveguides
summary: Frequency-division multiplexing is a key functionality for wave-based information processing, enabling multiple information channels to coexist within the same physical medium. Here, we experimentally investigate spin-wave multiplexing in a CoFeB waveguide using all-electrical excitation and detection. Two independently generated microwave signals are simultaneously coupled into the same spin-wave waveguide through inductive antennas and characterized using broadband vector network analyzer measurements. The transmission spectra obtained under single-channel and multiplexed operation exhibit excellent agreement, demonstrating that spin waves with different frequencies and wavelengths propagate simultaneously without measurable interaction in the linear regime. The observation is confirmed using both dual-sweep and sweep-plus-single-tone excitation schemes. A theoretical analysis based on linear superposition and phase-sensitive detection explains the absence of observable inter-channel interference for independent microwave sources. Micromagnetic simulations further confirm that the amplitudes and wavevectors of the individual spin-wave modes remain unchanged during co-propagation, demonstrating the absence of interaction over the entire propagation distance. The results provide direct experimental evidence that independent spin-wave channels can coexist in a single waveguide and support the implementation of frequency-division multiplexing in future magnonic computing and microwave signal-processing architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文实验证明在CoFeB波导中，不同频率和波长的自旋波可同时线性传播而无相互作用，为未来基于自旋波的频分复用计算和信号处理架构提供了直接实验证据。
AI.motivation: 频分复用是波基信息处理的关键功能，允许在同一物理介质中并存多个信息通道。本文旨在实验验证自旋波在波导中的频分复用可行性。
AI.method: 采用全电激发与检测方式，在CoFeB波导中通过感应天线同时耦合两个独立微波信号，利用宽带矢量网络分析仪测量传输谱，并采用双扫频和扫频加单音两种激发方案进行验证。通过线性叠加和相敏检测理论分析，以及微磁模拟进一步确认。

AI.conclusion: 提供了独立自旋波通道可在单一波导中共存的直接实验证据，支持未来在磁子计算和微波信号处理架构中实现频分复用。

title: Magnetoresistive Memory in the Paramagnetic Phase of Eu$_5$In$_2$As$_6$
summary: Magnetoresistive materials that respond sensitively to applied fields are central to modern data storage technologies. Here we unveil a novel Magnetoresistive Memory (MRM) in Eu$_5$In$_2$As$_6$, where the electrical resistivity depends not only on the magnitude but also on the history of the applied magnetic field. Such an effect has been reported in only two classes of strongly correlated electron systems: perovskite manganites and pyrochlore iridates. In both cases, the effect has been observed in the magnetically ordered phase. It has been attributed to metastable magnetic states in manganites and conducting domain walls in iridates. Remarkably, the MRM in Eu$_5$In$_2$As$_6$ onsets at twice the antiferromagnetic transition temperature, well within the paramagnetic phase. The temperature, field, and time dependence of resistivity suggest that either a hidden order or a fluctuating phase with short-range correlations underlies this effect. Our results offer MRM as a new platform for quantum sensing and memory technologies, and encourage searching for MRM in related materials.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种新型磁阻存储器（MRM）材料Eu₅In₂As₆，其电阻不仅依赖于磁场大小，还依赖于磁场历史，且在顺磁相中即可观察到该效应，为量子传感和存储技术提供了新平台。
AI.motivation: 寻找新型磁阻存储器（MRM）材料，拓展对磁阻效应的理解，并探索其在量子传感和存储技术中的应用潜力。
AI.method: 通过测量Eu₅In₂As₆在不同温度、磁场和时间条件下的电阻率变化，观察其电阻对磁场历史和幅度的依赖性。
AI.result: 发现Eu₅In₂As₆在反铁磁转变温度的两倍以上（顺磁相）即可出现MRM效应，其电阻率依赖于磁场的幅度和历史。
AI.conclusion: 这种效应可能源于隐藏序或短程关联的涨落相，为MRM提供了新平台，并鼓励在相关材料中进一步探索。

title: Numerical exploration on unveiling the photovoltaic potential of MgXS3(X = Ti, Zr, Hf) chalcogenide perovskites
summary: Lead-free chalcogenide perovskites offer a nontoxic and thermally robust path beyond Pb-based perovskite solar cells (PSCs), but their device-level behavior in realistic three-dimensional geometries remains insufficiently characterized. In this work, we investigate ZnSe/MgXS3(X = Ti, Zr, Hf)/Sb2S3 solar cell architecture where MgXS3 absorbers from the II-IV-VI chalcogenide perovskite family is employed as the absorber layer. The device is analyzed using 3D finite-element simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics that self-consistently couple optical generation, drift-diffusion carrier transport, and heat transfer under AM 1.5G 1-sun illumination, following a fully coupled opto-electro-thermal framework. For each absorber composition, the impacts of absorber thickness, doping, and defect density are systematically investigated, and the contribution of an Sb2S3 back-surface-field (BSF) layer to carrier collection and spectral response is quantified. Under optimized conditions, MgZrS3, MgTiS3, MgHfS3-based devices achieves a simulated power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 28.18%, 26.72%, and 28.16%, respectively. The corresponding open-circuit voltage (VOC) values are 0.94 V, 0.74 V, and, 1.07 V while the short-circuit current density (JSC) values are 34.46 mA/cm2, 42.69 mA/cm2, and 29.89 mA/cm2, with fill factor (FF) values of 86.99%, 84.58%, and 88.02%, respectively. Coupled electro-thermal simulations further reveal a small spatially non-uniform steady-state temperature rise across the ultrathin cell stack, mainly governed by non-radiative recombination and Joule dissipation within the active layers. Overall, these results confirm MgXS3(X = Ti, Zr, Hf) chalcogenide perovskites as promising lead-free absorber materials and offer practical design guidance for achieving high-efficiency, thermally stable three-dimensional device architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三维有限元仿真，研究了无铅硫系钙钛矿MgXS₃(X=Ti, Zr, Hf)作为吸收层的ZnSe/MgXS₃/Sb₂S₃太阳能电池结构，在优化条件下实现了最高28.18%的模拟效率，并分析了热效应对器件性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 无铅硫系钙钛矿虽具备无毒、热稳定性好等优势，但其在实际三维几何结构下的器件级行为尚未被充分表征，缺乏系统的光电热耦合分析。
AI.method: 采用COMSOL Multiphysics进行三维有限元仿真，自洽耦合光学生成、漂移-扩散载流子输运和热传递过程，系统研究吸收层厚度、掺杂浓度和缺陷密度的影响，并量化Sb₂S₃背表面场层的作用。
AI.result: 优化后的MgZrS₃、MgTiS₃、MgHfS₃基器件分别达到28.18%、26.72%和28.16%的PCE；VOC分别为0.94V、0.74V、1.07V；JSC分别为34.46、42.69、29.89 mA/cm²；FF分别为86.99%、84.58%、88.02%。电热耦合仿真显示电池堆栈内存在较小的非均匀稳态温升，主要由非辐射复合和焦耳耗散引起。
AI.conclusion: MgXS₃(X=Ti, Zr, Hf)硫系钙钛矿是极具前景的无铅吸收层材料，本研究为开发高效、热稳定的三维器件架构提供了实用设计指导。

title: Frequency-dependent electron-phonon coupling and vibrational responses in tight-binding and continuous Dirac models with nuclear velocity correction
summary: The nuclear motion induces in the electronic atomic orbitals a nuclear-velocity-dependent phase (also known as electron-translation factor), which modifies the effective Hamiltonians constructed from localised atomic orbitals. In this work, using an Ehrenfest Lagrangian approach for the localised atomic orbitals (LCAO) and tight-binding methods, we determine, at any order in the nuclear velocity, the equations of motion and the vibrational responses within a linear response formalism, focusing on the tight-binding assessment of the Born effective charges and the force-constant matrix. The appearance of nuclear-velocity-dependent Peierls-like phases in the non-local part of the interactions restores the all-electron sum rules for frequency-dependent vibrational responses. In tight-binding models these corrections crucially modify the vibrational response from a qualitative point of view, also yielding contributions required to capture phenomena such as vibrational circular dichroism. We test these corrections in the tight-binding model for metallic gapped graphene - finding excellent agreement with \textit{ab initio} calculations - and for the topological time-reversal symmetry breaking Haldane model.

AI.tldr: 本文利用埃伦费斯特拉格朗日方法，在局域化原子轨道（LCAO）和紧束缚（TB）框架下，推导了核速度依赖的Peierls类相位对振动响应的影响，发现这些相位修正了玻恩有效电荷和力常数矩阵，恢复了全电子求和规则，并在金属性带隙石墨烯和拓扑Haldane模型中验证了其准确性。
AI.motivation: 核运动会在电子轨道中引入核速度依赖的相位（电子平移因子），这种相位会影响从局域化原子轨道构建的有效哈密顿量。然而传统紧束缚模型常忽略这一效应，导致振动响应计算不准确。本文旨在系统推导这些相位修正，并检验其对振动响应的重要性。
AI.method: 采用埃伦费斯特拉格朗日方法，在LCAO和紧束缚框架下，推导任意阶核速度下的运动方程；通过线性响应形式，计算玻恩有效电荷和力常数矩阵。特别关注非局域相互作用中的核速度依赖Peierls类相位对振动响应的影响。
AI.result: 核速度依赖的Peierls类相位恢复了频率依赖振动响应的全电子求和规则；在紧束缚模型中，这些修正从定性上改变了振动响应，并产生了捕捉振动圆二色性等现象所需的贡献。在金属性带隙石墨烯中与ab initio计算结果高度一致；在拓扑Haldane模型中也验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 核速度依赖的Peierls类相位修正对于紧束缚模型中振动响应的准确计算至关重要，不仅能恢复求和规则，还能描述振动圆二色性等物理现象。该方法在石墨烯和Haldane模型中的成功验证表明其具有广泛适用性。

title: Proximity-induced charge transfer, strain and magnetic exchange in graphene/CrSBr heterostructure
summary: Stacking van der Waals materials provides a powerful route to engineer emergent electronic and magnetic behaviors through proximity-driven interactions. The graphene/CrSBr heterostructure has emerged as a compelling platform in this frontier, exhibiting exotic macroscopic responses-- including uniaxial surface-plasmon-polariton propagation and an unconventional quantum Hall effect-- indicative of strong interfacial electronic and magnetic coupling. However, a microscopic electronic landscape governing these phenomena has remained elusive. Here, we provide a comprehensive spectroscopic characterization of the graphene/CrSBr interface using a combination of angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), low-energy electron microscopy (LEEM), and density functional theory. We resolve a massive redistribution of interfacial charge that concurrently hole dopes graphene and populates the quasi-one-dimensional spin-polarized conduction band of CrSBr, resulting insulator-to-metal transition in the interfacial CrSBr layer. Furthermore, electronic structure of CrSBr exhibits strong momentum-dependent renormalization distinct from conventional charge doping, and theoretical modeling supported by Raman spectroscopy points to additional interfacial compressive strain. In addition, ARPES reveals a splitting-like feature in the graphene Dirac cone consistent with spin degeneracy lifting, providing possible evidence of magnetic proximity coupling. These findings provide crucial microscopic insight into the system's optical and transport responses and establish graphene/CrSBr as a versatile platform for charge-transfer control, strain-driven band engineering, magnetic-proximity coupling, and directionally confined excitations for next-generation spintronic and nanophotonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过ARPES、LEEM和DFT等手段，揭示了石墨烯/CrSBr异质结界面存在巨大的电荷重新分布、应变效应以及可能的磁近邻耦合，为理解其宏观光电和输运行为提供了微观基础。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯/CrSBr异质结表现出奇特的宏观响应（如单轴表面等离子体激元和反常量子霍尔效应），但其背后的微观电子学图像尚不清晰。
AI.method: 结合角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）、低能电子显微镜（LEEM）、密度泛函理论（DFT）及拉曼光谱，对石墨烯/CrSBr界面进行全面的谱学表征。
AI.result: 发现了界面处巨大的电荷重新分布：石墨烯被空穴掺杂，CrSBr的准一维自旋极化导带被填充，界面层发生绝缘体-金属转变；CrSBr的电子结构呈现动量依赖的重整化；ARPES观测到狄拉克锥劈裂特征，提示自旋简并解除。
AI.conclusion: 这些微观发现揭示了体系光电和输运响应的根源，确立了石墨烯/CrSBr作为电荷转移、应变工程、磁近邻耦合和定向受限激发多功能平台的潜力，对下一代自旋电子学和纳米光子学器件具有重要价值。

title: The origin of ferroelectricity, polarization and high resistivity in Aurivillius CaBi2B2O9 (B = Ta, Nb)
summary: Aurivillius layered oxides are important candidates for high-temperature ferroelectric and piezoelectric application. In this work, we combine group theoretic analysis with first-principles calculations to systematically investigate the origin of ferroelectric phase transition, polarization, piezoelectric response, and intrinsic electrical insulation of the two-layer Aurivillius ferroelectrics CaBi$_{2}$B$_{2}$O$_{9}$ (B = Ta, Nb). The results show that the \textit{A2$_1$am} ferroelectric phase arises from the cooperative condensation of a polar mode and nonpolar oxygen octahedral rotation/tilting modes, whose the $Γ_5^-$X$_2^+$X$_3^-$ trilinear coupling substantially lowers the total energy and deepens the ferroelectric potential well. The spontaneous polarization and anisotropic piezoelectric response are governed primarily by the cooperative displacements of the Bi$_{2}$O$_{2}$ layers and Ta/NbO$_{6}$ octahedra, with Bi ions providing an indispensable contribution to both responses. More importantly, the polar distortion can be traced to the relative in-plane displacement between adjacent the Bi$_{2}$O$_{2}$ layer and the perovskite-like block. Because this displacement is intrinsic to the alternating Bi$_{2}$O$_{2}$/perovskite-block stacking topology and is independent of the number of perovskite layers, we identify interlayer sliding as a general, layer-number-independent structural mechanism for ferroelectricity in Aurivillius oxides. Our findings establish a unified microscopic picture linking structural distortions, ferroelectric polarization, piezoelectric response, and electronic insulation in CaBi$_{2}$B$_{2}$O$_{9}$ (B = Ta, Nb), and provide theoretical guidance for designing layered ferroelectric oxides with high Curie temperatures and robust insulating behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过群论分析和第一性原理计算，系统研究了双层Aurivillius铁电体CaBi₂B₂O₉（B=Ta, Nb）中铁电相变、极化、压电响应及电绝缘性的起源。发现A2₁am铁电相由极性模与非极性氧八面体旋转/倾斜模协同凝聚形成，并揭示了层间滑移作为Aurivillius氧化物铁电性普遍结构机制的本质。
AI.motivation: Aurivillius层状氧化物是高温铁电和压电应用的重要候选材料，但其铁电性起源、极化机制及压电响应的微观图像尚不清晰，缺乏统一的机理解释。
AI.method: 结合群论分析（Group Theoretic Analysis）与第一性原理计算（First-Principles Calculations），对CaBi₂B₂O₉（B=Ta, Nb）进行系统研究。
AI.result: (1) A2₁am铁电相源于极性模Γ₅⁻与非极性氧八面体旋转/倾斜模X₂⁺X₃⁻的三线性耦合，大幅降低总能并加深铁电势阱；(2) 自发极化和各向异性压电响应主要受Bi₂O₂层和Ta/NbO₆八面体的协同位移主导；(3) 极化畸变可追溯到相邻Bi₂O₂层与类钙钛矿块之间的面内相对位移，该位移对层数不敏感。

title: Angular Momentum Quantization of a Charge-flux Composite: Quantum Electrodynamic Approach
summary: The fractional angular momentum of a two-dimensional charge-flux composite is a well-established phenomenon usually derived from a semiclassical Hamiltonian. However, when the composite is treated as an isolated system in free two-dimensional space, the fundamental rotational and reflection symmetries of the $O(2)$ group demand that its total angular momentum is strictly quantized. We address this conceptual discrepancy by applying a full quantum electrodynamic (QED) approach combined with Noether's theorem. We demonstrate that the interaction between the charge and flux, mediated by the vacuum electromagnetic field, generates an intrinsic interaction angular momentum composed of both field momentum and hidden relativistic momentum. This gauge-invariant interaction angular momentum exactly compensates for the fractional part of the kinetic angular momentum. Consequently, the net angular momentum of the composite strictly follows the integer or half-integer quantization rule. Our formalism clarifies that the conventional fractional spin corresponds to the expectation value of the kinetic angular momentum within the perturbed QED ground state. It also elucidates why the standard classical field angular momentum definition fails to capture this in two dimensions, due to non-vanishing boundary terms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过完整QED方法证明：二维电荷-通量复合体的总角动量严格遵循整数或半整数量子化规则，其分数部分由真空电磁场中介导的相互作用角动量精确补偿。
AI.motivation: 解决二维电荷-通量复合体分数角动量与O(2)群基本对称性要求（总角动量严格量子化）之间的概念矛盾。
AI.method: 采用全量子电动力学（QED）结合诺特定理，分析电荷与通量通过真空电磁场介导的相互作用，并分离出场动量和隐藏相对论动量的贡献。
AI.result: 1. 发现相互作用角动量（包含场动量和隐藏相对论动量）恰好补偿了动能角动量的分数部分。2. 净角动量严格遵循整数或半整数量子化规则。3. 经典场角动量定义在二维中因非零边界项而失效。
AI.conclusion: 传统的分数自旋实为微扰QED基态下动能角动量的期望值；完整的QED处理恢复了角动量的正确量子化，调和了理论矛盾。

title: Quantum Fisher Information in semiclassical magnon systems
summary: Quantum Fisher Information (QFI) is a powerful spectroscopic tool to witness many-body quantum entanglement in solid state materials, but it is not always obvious how to relate it to other characteristics of condensed matter systems. In this study we elaborate on the meaning and interpretation of QFI in condensed matter by examining simple theoretical spin systems. We use finite sized spin systems to illustrate that QFI quantifies the momentum- dependent degree of quantum entanglement (that is the entanglement depth at a given wave vector) within a wave function. We subsequently use semiclassical frustrated spin models to show that, in the context of linear spin wave theory (LSWT), QFI quantifies the momentum-dependent degree of magnon squeezing in the ground state. In antiferromagnets with a zero-energy Goldstone mode, LSWT breaks down and QFI (and entanglement depth) diverges at the magnetic ordering wave vector. We also show examples of emergent quantum phases in frustrated spin systems that do not appear in classical phase diagrams. When these emergent phases are approached, QFI diverges across multiple wave vectors in momentum space. Taken together, QFI is not only helpful as a lower bound for entanglement depth, but serves as a momentum-resolved probe of entanglement that offers a novel perspective on quantum critical phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论自旋系统模型，阐明量子Fisher信息（QFI）在凝聚态物质中可作为动量分辨的量子纠缠探针，量化纠缠深度和磁振子压缩，并在量子临界现象中发散。
AI.motivation: QFI是见证多体量子纠缠的有力光谱工具，但如何将其与凝聚态系统的其他特性联系起来并不明确，因此需要阐明QFI在凝聚态中的含义和解释。
AI.method: 使用有限尺寸自旋系统说明QFI量化动量依赖的纠缠深度；利用半经典阻挫自旋模型和线性自旋波理论（LSWT）展示QFI量化基态磁振子压缩程度；分析反铁磁体中Goldstone零能模导致LSWT失效时QFI的发散行为。
AI.result: QFI可量化动量依赖的纠缠深度；在LSWT框架下量化磁振子压缩；在反铁磁体磁性有序波矢处QFI发散；阻挫自旋系统中出现经典相图不存在的量子相，接近时QFI在多个波矢处发散。
AI.conclusion: QFI不仅是纠缠深度的下界，更是动量分辨的量子纠缠探针，为量子临界现象提供新视角。

title: Symmetry-Based Design Rules for Second-Harmonic Generation in Stacked and Twisted MoS2 Bilayers
summary: Understanding how stacking controls the nonlinear optical response of two-dimensional materials is key to designing van der Waals heterostructures with tailored functionalities. Here, we establish a comprehensive symmetry-based framework mapping the structural configuration of MoS2 bilayers across four point groups (D3h, D3d, C3v, C3) to their second-order susceptibility tensor chi^(2). Using group-theory arguments benchmarked against first-principles calculations, we demonstrate how symmetry breaking controls the activation and suppression of individual tensor elements in these systems. We show that the emergence of the in-plane component chi_xxx in twisted configurations (C3 group) induces a rigid azimuthal rotation of the second-harmonic generation polar lobes, which remains frequency-independent across the entire optical spectrum, locking to half of the structural twist angle. Our findings establish a direct, wavelength-independent optical route for twist-angle determination and provide a clear roadmap for engineering nonlinear optical responses in two-dimensional materials.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个基于对称性的框架，将MoS₂双层在不同点群（D3h, D3d, C3v, C3）下的结构构型与其二阶非线性光学响应张量χ^(2)联系起来。研究发现，扭转构型（C3群）中面内分量χ_xxx的出现导致二次谐波产生极瓣发生刚性方位旋转，该旋转角度锁定为结构扭转角的一半，且在整个光谱范围内与频率无关。
AI.motivation: 理解堆叠方式如何控制二维材料的非线性光学响应，对于设计具有定制功能的范德华异质结至关重要。该研究旨在建立结构构型与非线性光学响应之间的明确映射关系。
AI.method: 使用群论方法，结合第一性原理计算进行验证，系统分析了MoS₂双层在四种点群（D3h, D3d, C3v, C3）下的二阶非线性光学张量χ^(2)。
AI.result: 发现扭转构型中面内分量χ_xxx的激活导致二次谐波极瓣产生刚性旋转，且旋转角锁定为结构扭转角的一半，该效应与频率无关。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一种直接的、与波长无关的扭转角确定光学方法，并为工程化二维材料非线性光学响应提供了清晰路线图。

title: Interface-resolved structural properties of epitaxial Y$_3$Fe$_5$O$_{12}$/ Gd$_3$Fe$_5$O$_{12}$ bilayers grown on GGG(111) by pulsed laser deposition
summary: Epitaxial Y$_3$Fe$_5$O$_{12}$ (YIG) and Gd$_3$Fe$_5$O$_{12}$ (GdIG) thin films, along with their bilayer heterostructures, were grown on Gd$_3$Ga$_5$O$_{12}$(GGG)(111) substrates using pulsed laser deposition. Structural properties were investigated using X-ray diffraction, reciprocal space mapping, and cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy. The results confirm high crystalline quality and coherent epitaxial growth, with RSM revealing a coexistence of strained and partially relaxed regions governed by layer sequence. TEM analysis shows sharp interfaces, columnar microstructures, and antiphase boundaries that facilitate strain relaxation. A comparative study indicates that the GGG/YIG/GdIG stacking sequence exhibits improved structural quality with reduced defect density, attributed to the superior epitaxial growth of YIG on the substrate. These findings highlight the critical role of growth sequence in controlling strain and interfacial structure in garnet heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过脉冲激光沉积在GGG(111)衬底上生长了YIG和GdIG薄膜及其双层异质结构，系统研究了不同生长序列对晶体质量、应变状态和界面结构的影响，发现GGG/YIG/GdIG堆叠顺序具有更优的结构质量和更低的缺陷密度。
AI.motivation: 石榴石异质结构在自旋电子学等领域有重要应用，但不同生长序列对应变调控和界面质量的影响尚不明确，需系统研究生长顺序对结构性能的调控作用。
AI.method: 采用脉冲激光沉积(PLD)方法生长YIG和GdIG薄膜及其双层异质结构；利用X射线衍射(XRD)、倒易空间映射(RSM)和截面透射电子显微镜(TEM)进行结构表征。
AI.result: 所有薄膜均表现出高结晶质量和共格外延生长；RSM显示应变和部分弛豫区域共存，且受层序列控制；TEM观察到清晰界面、柱状微结构和反相边界（作为应变弛豫途径）；GGG/YIG/GdIG序列具有更优的结构质量和更低的缺陷密度。
AI.conclusion: 生长序列在石榴石异质结构中对应变和界面结构的控制起着关键作用，YIG在衬底上的优越外延生长是改善结构质量的主要原因。

title: Huge hole injection in tungsten dichalcogenide heterostructures without electric gating: a DFT study
comment: 9 pages, 2 Figures, 3 Tables and electronic supplement of 22 pages
summary: Van der Waals heterostructures based on transition metal dichalcogenides, TMDs, provide a versatile platform for tailoring electronic properties through interlayer charge transfer, CT. Precise control of CT is essential because it directly determines the electronic structure and carrier concentration in atomically thin materials. Recently, the concept of a chemical capacitor has been proposed as a route to achieving exceptionally high carrier densities through CT across insulating separator layers. Here, we extend this concept to van der Waals heterostructures by investigating TMD hBN OX, oxidizer, systems using density functional theory, DFT. Following the screening of candidate TMDs and electron acceptors, XeF2 and KrF2 were identified as suitable acceptors exhibiting type III broken gap band alignment with WS2 and WSe2, respectively. Periodic DFT calculations of large supercells reveal CT corresponding to hole concentrations of up to 0.23 h+ and 0.35 h+ per W atom in WS2 hBN XeF2 and WSe2 hBN KrF2 heterostructures, respectively. The resulting charge redistribution demonstrates that noble gas fluorides provide an efficient route for noncontact engineering of carrier density in TMD heterostructures, offering a new strategy for tuning correlated electronic phases in two dimensional materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT计算研究了TMD/hBN/贵气体氟化物（XeF₂、KrF₂）范德华异质结中的化学电容效应，发现该类体系可实现高达0.23 h⁺/W（WS₂）和0.35 h⁺/W（WSe₂）的空穴浓度，为非接触式调控二维材料载流子密度提供了新策略。
AI.motivation: 精确控制层间电荷转移（CT）对调控TMD异质结的电子结构和载流子浓度至关重要，而化学电容概念为实现超高载流子密度提供了新思路。本文旨在将这一概念拓展至范德华异质结体系。
AI.method: 筛选候选TMD和电子受体，识别出XeF₂和KrF₂分别与WS₂和WSe₂形成III型（broken gap）能带对齐；利用周期性DFT计算大超胞体系，分析电荷转移和载流子浓度。
AI.result: WS₂/hBN/XeF₂和WSe₂/hBN/KrF₂异质结中分别实现了每W原子0.23 h⁺和0.35 h⁺的空穴浓度。
AI.conclusion: 贵气体氟化物为实现TMD异质结中载流子密度的非接触式调控提供了高效途径，为调控二维材料中的关联电子相开辟了新策略。

title: Exploring Multifunctionality in MgO-Based Magnetic Tunnel Junctions with Coexisting Magnetoresistance and Memristive Properties
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures adn 1 table. Published version of record. Published in Advanced Functional Materials 33 (2023), 2305238
summary: Magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) and memristors are two key emerging nanotechnologies that attracted significant interest for potential applications at the forefront of the digital revolution, including sensing, data storage, and non-conventional computation. The co-integration of these phenomena into a single multifunctional device is an important step toward harnessing the re-programmability of memristive systems with the high yield and varied functionality of MTJs. This study demonstrates the co-existence of magnetoresistance and memristive properties on MgO-based MTJs. These devices show a magnetoresistance with a linear response as a function of a magnetic field and no hysteresis, which are the requirements for good magnetic field sensors, as well as demonstrating a non-volatile and quasi-analogue memristive behavior as a function of an applied electrical field down to nanosecond pulses. Furthermore, by doping the oxide barrier, the memristive power consumption is lowered by 20% giving the multi-functionality of the devices a promising scalability potential. This study also shows that, memristive switching can be reversibly used to completely suppress and recover the spintronic functionalities. These results can pave the way for a seamless co-integration of memristors and spintronic devices in complex reprogrammable circuits addressing applications such as reprogrammable multifunctional field sensor arrays and neuromorphic computing.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了基于MgO的磁性隧道结(MTJs)中磁阻与忆阻特性的共存，实现了磁敏传感与忆阻可编程性的多功能集成，并通过掺杂氧化物势垒降低20%功耗，为可重构电路和神经形态计算开辟新路径。
AI.motivation: 将磁性隧道结(MTJ)的高产出、多功能特性与忆阻器的可重编程能力整合到单个器件中，实现两者的无缝协同集成，满足传感器、存储和非传统计算等应用需求。
AI.method: 在MgO基MTJ器件中同时实现磁阻效应（线性、无滞后的磁场响应）和忆阻效应（非易失、准模拟、纳秒脉冲电控），并通过掺杂氧化物势垒降低忆阻功耗20%。
AI.result: 器件展示了线性无滞后的磁阻响应（适合磁场传感），以及非易失准模拟的忆阻行为（纳秒级脉冲操控）；忆阻开关可逆地抑制/恢复自旋电子功能；掺杂后功耗降低20%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为忆阻器与自旋电子器件的无缝集成铺平道路，可用于可重构多功能场传感器阵列和神经形态计算等复杂可编程电路。

title: Thickness-dependent crack suppression and wrinkle formation in freestanding BaTiO3 membranes
summary: Freestanding ferroelectric oxide membranes offer a promising route toward silicon-integrated low-power electronic and memory devices, but reproducible membrane quality remains challenging, particularly in ultrathin BaTiO3 (BTO), where cracking and wrinkling hinder integration. Here, we show that crack and wrinkle formation in released BaTiO3 membranes can be tuned by jointly controlling oxide thickness and polymer support thickness. Reducing the BaTiO3 thickness from 15 nm to 5 nm suppresses large-area, optically visible cracking across the analysed regions, but promotes dense nanoscale wrinkling, revealing a trade-off between fracture mitigation and morphological instability. In 10 nm BaTiO3 membranes, polymer support thickness further modulates wrinkling, with an intermediate thickness reducing wrinkle density. Piezoresponse force microscopy reveals time-dependent evolution of written contrast after release, indicating that apparent ferroelectric response is influenced by polarization switching, post-release morphology, interfacial contact, charge screening, and strain relaxation. These results establish processing guidelines for integrating freestanding ferroelectrics into future devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调控BaTiO₃膜厚和聚合物支撑层厚度，揭示了超薄铁电膜在释放过程中的裂纹与褶皱之间的权衡关系，为硅基集成铁电器件提供了工艺指导。
AI.motivation: 独立式铁电氧化物膜有望用于硅集成的低功耗电子和存储器件，但超薄BaTiO₃膜在释放过程中容易出现裂纹和褶皱，严重影响膜的质量和器件可靠性，亟需建立可控的制备工艺。
AI.method: 系统调控BaTiO₃厚度（5-15 nm）和聚合物支撑层厚度，利用光学显微镜、原子力显微镜、压电力显微镜等手段表征裂纹、褶皱形貌及铁电响应的时间演化。
AI.result: 减少BTO厚度（15 nm→5 nm）可抑制可见裂纹但引发密集纳米褶皱，存在断裂抑制与形貌失稳之间的权衡；10 nm BTO中适中的聚合物厚度可降低褶皱密度；PFM揭示铁电响应受极化翻转、释放后形貌、界面接触、电荷屏蔽和应变弛豫共同影响。
AI.conclusion: 建立了独立式铁电膜的质量调控准则，为未来器件集成提供了工艺窗口。

title: From MLIPs to Microstructure: A High-Throughput Computational Framework to Design Spinodal Alloys in High-Dimensional Composition Spaces via Analytic Derivatives of CALPHAD Model Predictions
summary: Identifying regions of design space subject to spinodal decomposition is a critical component of alloy design in high-dimensional composition spaces. In cases where designers are seeking to exploit spinodal microstructures to tailor alloy properties, prediction of microstructure evolution and morphology is also needed. In this work, we present a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP)-trained, CALPHAD-based, open-source workflow for high-throughput microstructure stability analysis and visualization. In this workflow, coherent strain contributions are captured via high-throughput MLIP elastic constant calculations. To predict microstructure morphology for compositions of interest, MLIP-generated thermodynamic models are fed into an elasto-chemical phase field simulation. Both stability analyses and phase-field simulations utilize analytically-derived Gibbs energy Hessians to improve computational efficiency and accuracy over finite difference approximations. We demonstrate this workflow by investigating microstructure stability in the Hf-Nb-Ti-V quaternary system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于机器学习原子间势（MLIP）和CALPHAD的开源工作流，用于高吞吐量的微观结构稳定性分析和可视化，通过MLIP弹性常数计算捕捉相干应变贡献，并利用MLIP热力学模型进行弹-化学相场模拟，在Hf-Nb-Ti-V四元系中进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 在高维成分空间中，识别旋节分解区域对合金设计至关重要，但现有方法难以高效处理相干应变贡献和微观形貌预测，因此需要开发一个高吞吐量的自动化工作流。
AI.method: 采用MLIP训练的热力学模型，结合CALPHAD方法，通过高吞吐量MLIP弹性常数计算捕捉相干应变；利用解析推导的Gibbs能量Hessian矩阵替代有限差分近似，提升计算效率和精度；将MLIP生成的热力学模型输入弹-化学相场模拟预测微观结构形貌。
AI.result: 在Hf-Nb-Ti-V四元系中成功展示了该工作流在微观结构稳定性分析和相场模拟中的有效性，验证了相干应变贡献的捕捉能力和形貌预测的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该开源工作流为高维成分空间的合金设计提供了高效、精确的微观结构稳定性分析工具，可推广至其他多组元合金体系。

title: Role of Resonant $\mathbf{k}$-Points in the Transient Optical Response of Pumped Germanium
summary: Pump-induced transient optical properties combine contributions from electronic states throughout the Brillouin zone, but the relative relevance of off-resonant and l-photon resonant crystal momenta has remained unexplored. We address this issue in pumped germanium by resolving the transient absorptive response into momentum-space classes defined by the presence or absence of 1-, 2-, and 3-photon resonances with respect to the pump. Using the Dynamical Projective Operatorial Approach together with the related generalized linear response theory, we compute the differential imaginary part of the dielectric function and evaluate the contributions of each resonance class. Resonant regions account for nearly the entire optical response, whereas points outside the identified resonance sets contribute only negligibly. Nevertheless, the 2-photon-resonant set, although containing more than 98% of the residual (post-pump) excitation population, does not reproduce the full transient spectrum. Conversely, resonance classes with very small residual populations generate non-negligible contributions to the transient optical properties. This mismatch shows that the transient optical weight is not determined solely by the real-charge dynamics (which results in post-pulse residual excitation population) and is consistent with substantial virtual pump-induced contributions, whose dominant optical weight nevertheless arises from the resonant regions of momentum space. The class-resolved phase of the dominant 2$ω_{\mathrm{pu}}$ oscillations further shows that, whenever a class contributes appreciably, the phase of its oscillatory component follows that of the corresponding full signal. The resulting decomposition provides a momentum-resolved connection among multi-photon resonances and transient optical observables in a realistic material.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将泵浦诱导的瞬态光学响应按动量空间中的1、2、3光子共振分类，发现共振区域贡献了几乎全部光学响应，而2光子共振区虽占激发群体的98%以上却无法复现完整瞬态光谱，揭示了瞬态光学权重并非仅由实电荷动力学决定，且存在显著的虚部泵浦诱导贡献。
AI.motivation: 探索泵浦诱导瞬态光学特性中，离共振与1光子共振晶体动量点的相对重要性——这一此前未被研究的问题。
AI.method: 使用动力学投影算符方法（DPO）结合广义线性响应理论，计算微分介电函数虚部，并对动量空间按1、2、3光子共振分类进行贡献分解。
AI.result: 共振区域贡献了几乎全部瞬态光学响应；2光子共振区含98%以上残余激发群体但无法复现全瞬态光谱；具有极小残余群体（如1光子共振区）的类别产生不可忽略的贡献；主导2ω_pu振荡的相位在不同类别中保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 瞬态光学权重不完全由实电荷动力学（残余激发群体）决定，虚部泵浦诱导贡献显著；共振动量区域是光学权重的决定性因素；该分解为多光子共振与瞬态光学可观测量的动量分辨联系提供了基础。

title: Competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic interactions in non-altermagnetic Ru$_{1-x}$Cr$_{x}$O$_{2}$
summary: We investigate the proposal of hole doping RuO$_{2}$ via alloying with Cr ions to induce altermagnetism. Thin film samples of Ru$_{1-x}$Cr$_{x}$O$_{2}$ ($0 \leq x \leq 0.28$) were prepared by reactive magnetron co-sputtering on TiO$_{2}$ substrates, with epitaxial nature verified by X-ray diffraction and composition depth profiles determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy combined with Ar etching. Neutron diffraction measurements of samples with $x = 0$ and $x = 0.23$ at low temperatures show no evidence of long-range altermagnetic order with spins oriented along the $c$-axis or within the $ab$-plane. In contrast, temperature dependent susceptibility measurements in samples with $x \geq 0.16$ show a gradual downturn below $T\approx20~$K, suggestive of antiferromagnetic interactions, although this coexists with ferromagnetic hysteresis and remnant magnetization at $4~$K for samples with $x \geq 0.23$. Together, our magnetometry and neutron scattering measurements suggest the coexistence of antiferromagnetically coupled ferromagnetic CrO\textsubscript{2} clusters. This indicates that Cr ions do not hole dope Ru bands to induce an altermagnet state, but rather the holes remain localized to the Cr ions.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过Cr掺杂RuO₂试图诱导交变磁性，但实验表明Cr离子并未实现空穴掺杂Ru能带，而是形成局域化的反铁磁耦合铁磁CrO₂团簇，未观察到长程交变磁有序。
AI.motivation: 探索通过Cr合金化在RuO₂中掺杂空穴以诱导交变磁性的可能性。
AI.method: 采用反应磁控共溅射制备Ru₁₋ₓCrₓO₂薄膜样品，通过X射线衍射验证外延性质，X射线光电子能谱结合Ar刻蚀分析成分深度分布，利用中子衍射测量磁结构，并进行温度依赖的磁化率测量。
AI.result: 中子衍射显示无长程交变磁有序；x≥0.16样品在T≈20K以下出现磁化率下降（反铁磁相互作用），但x≥0.23样品在4K下同时表现出铁磁滞后和剩余磁化，表明存在反铁磁耦合的铁磁CrO₂团簇。
AI.conclusion: Cr离子并未通过空穴掺杂Ru能带来诱导交变磁态，空穴局域在Cr离子上，形成了反铁磁耦合的铁磁团簇。
